import YulangClosure.HigherOrderHandlerSafety
import YulangClosure.HigherOrderGraphSafety

namespace YulangClosure.HandlerGraph
open YulangClosure.HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend OperationInstance
  ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate PathCorrespondence)

/-! Candidate recursively extended syntax. Every attempt is actual Comp R S code.
An operation arm binds payload at zero and the original shallow continuation at
one. Eligibility is raw data; its permission interpretation is deliberately open.
No definition below supplies typing as syntax or as an operational premise. -/

mutual
  inductive Value (R S : Type) where
    | ref (reference : R)
    | recvar (name : S)
    | var (index : Nat)
    | unit
    | bool (value : Bool)
    | int (value : Int)
    | floatBits (value : UInt64)
    | string (value : String)
    | bytes (value : List UInt8)
    | path (value : List UInt8)
    | char (value : String)
    | delay (body : Comp R S)
    | inLeft (value : Value R S)
    | inRight (value : Value R S)
    | both (value : Value R S)
    | top (value : Value R S)
    | view (value : Value R S) (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
    | lambda (mode : Original.Mode) (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
        (argument bodyResult result : Ty) (body : Comp R S) (consumer : Adapter R S)
    | wrap (inner : Value R S) (input output : Adapter R S)
  inductive Comp (R S : Type) where
    | ret (value : Value R S)
    | force (value : Value R S)
    | bind (first body : Comp R S)
    | unionCase (value : Value R S) (left right : Comp R S)
    | chooseLeft (value : Value R S)
    | chooseRight (value : Value R S)
    | absurd (value : Value R S)
    | scope (owner : Nat) (body : Comp R S)
    | expose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence) (body : Comp R S)
    | request (op : OperationInstance) (payload : Value R S) (continuation : Comp R S)
    | fail (reason : Original.Failure)
    | dynamicCall (function argument : Value R S)
    | handle (handler : Handler R S) (body : Comp R S)
    | tryValue (handler : Handler R S) (value : Value R S) (arms : ValueArms R S)
    | waitValue (handler : Handler R S) (value : Value R S) (remaining : ValueArms R S) (attempt : Comp R S)
    | tryOperation (handler : Handler R S) (op : OperationInstance) (payload : Value R S) (continuation : Comp R S) (arms : OperationArms R S)
    | waitOperation (handler : Handler R S) (op : OperationInstance) (payload : Value R S) (continuation : Comp R S) (remaining : OperationArms R S) (attempt : Comp R S)
  inductive Handler (R S : Type) where
    | mk (identity : Nat) (input output : Ty) (values : ValueArms R S) (operations : OperationArms R S)
  inductive ValueArms (R S : Type) where
    | nil
    | cons (body : Comp R S) (rest : ValueArms R S)
  inductive OperationArms (R S : Type) where
    | nil
    | cons (op : OperationInstance) (eligible : Bool) (body : Comp R S) (rest : OperationArms R S)
  inductive Adapter (R S : Type) where
    | mk (input output : Ty) (body : Comp R S)
        (paths : List PathCorrespondence) (views : List ViewOccurrence)
end


mutual
  inductive ValueTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → Value R S → Ty → Prop
    | ref (r : R) : ValueTyped xi nu env (.ref r) (xi r)
    | recvar (s : S) : ValueTyped xi nu env (.recvar s) (nu s)
    | var : env i = some a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.var i) a
    | unit : ValueTyped xi nu env .unit (.base .unit)
    | bool : ValueTyped xi nu env (.bool v) (.base .bool)
    | int : ValueTyped xi nu env (.int v) (.base .int)
    | floatBits : ValueTyped xi nu env (.floatBits v) (.base .float)
    | string : ValueTyped xi nu env (.string v) (.base .string)
    | bytes : ValueTyped xi nu env (.bytes v) (.base .bytes)
    | path : ValueTyped xi nu env (.path v) (.base .path)
    | char : ValueTyped xi nu env (.char v) (.base .char)
    | delay : CompTyped xi nu env m a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.delay m) (.thunk a)
    | inLeft : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.inLeft v) (.union a b)
    | inRight : ValueTyped xi nu env v b → ValueTyped xi nu env (.inRight v) (.union a b)
    | both : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env v b →
        ValueTyped xi nu env (.both v) (.intersection a b)
    | top : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.top v) .top
    | view : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueTyped xi nu env (.view v occurrence) a
    | lambdaValue : CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) body b → AdapterTyped xi nu env consumer b r →
        ValueTyped xi nu env (.lambda .value receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
    | lambdaComputation : CompTyped xi nu (extend env (.thunk a)) body b → AdapterTyped xi nu env consumer b r →
        ValueTyped xi nu env (.lambda .computation receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
    | wrap : ValueTyped xi nu env f (.callable a b) → AdapterTyped xi nu env input c a →
        AdapterTyped xi nu env output b d → ValueTyped xi nu env (.wrap f input output) (.callable c d)
  inductive CompTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → Comp R S → Ty → Prop
    | ret : ValueTyped xi nu env v a → CompTyped xi nu env (.ret v) a
    | force : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.thunk a) → CompTyped xi nu env (.force v) a
    | bind : CompTyped xi nu env m a → CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) n b →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.bind m n) b
    | unionCase : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.union a b) →
        CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) l c → CompTyped xi nu (extend env b) r c →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.unionCase v l r) c
    | chooseLeft : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.intersection a b) → CompTyped xi nu env (.chooseLeft v) a
    | chooseRight : ValueTyped xi nu env v (.intersection a b) → CompTyped xi nu env (.chooseRight v) b
    | absurd : ValueTyped xi nu env v .bottom → CompTyped xi nu env (.absurd v) a
    | scope : CompTyped xi nu env body a → CompTyped xi nu env (.scope owner body) a
    | expose : CompTyped xi nu env body a → CompTyped xi nu env (.expose ev rv body) a
    | request : ValueTyped xi nu env payload op.payloadType →
        CompTyped xi nu (extend env op.responseType) continuation a →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.request op payload continuation) a
    | fail : CompTyped xi nu env (.fail reason) a
    | dynamicCall : ValueTyped xi nu env f (.callable a b) → ValueTyped xi nu env arg (.thunk a) →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.dynamicCall f arg) b
    | handle : HandlerTyped xi nu env h a b → CompTyped xi nu env m a → CompTyped xi nu env (.handle h m) b
    | tryValue : HandlerTyped xi nu env h a b → ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.tryValue h v arms) b
    | waitValue : HandlerTyped xi nu env h a b → ValueTyped xi nu env v a → ValueArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b →
        CompTyped xi nu env attempt (.union (.base .unit) b) → CompTyped xi nu env (.waitValue h v arms attempt) b
    | tryOperation : HandlerTyped xi nu env h a b → ValueTyped xi nu env p op.payloadType →
        CompTyped xi nu (extend env op.responseType) k a → OperationArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b →
        CompTyped xi nu env (.tryOperation h op p k arms) b
    | waitOperation : HandlerTyped xi nu env h a b → ValueTyped xi nu env p op.payloadType →
        CompTyped xi nu (extend env op.responseType) k a → OperationArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b →
        CompTyped xi nu env attempt (.union (.base .unit) b) → CompTyped xi nu env (.waitOperation h op p k arms attempt) b
  inductive HandlerTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → Handler R S → Ty → Ty → Prop where
    | mk : ValueArmsTyped xi nu env vs a b → OperationArmsTyped xi nu env os a b →
        HandlerTyped xi nu env (.mk identity a b vs os) a b
  inductive ValueArmsTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → ValueArms R S → Ty → Ty → Prop where
    | nil : ValueArmsTyped xi nu env .nil a b
    | cons : CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) body (.union (.base .unit) b) →
        ValueArmsTyped xi nu env rest a b → ValueArmsTyped xi nu env (.cons body rest) a b
  inductive OperationArmsTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → OperationArms R S → Ty → Ty → Prop where
    | nil : OperationArmsTyped xi nu env .nil a b
    | cons : CompTyped xi nu (extend (extend env (.callable op.responseType a)) op.payloadType)
          body (.union (.base .unit) b) → OperationArmsTyped xi nu env rest a b →
        OperationArmsTyped xi nu env (.cons op eligible body rest) a b
  inductive AdapterTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) : Context → Adapter R S → Ty → Ty → Prop where
    | mk : CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) body b →
        AdapterTyped xi nu env (.mk a b body paths views) a b
end




variable {R S : Type} {xi : R → Ty} {nu : S → Ty}

mutual
  def renameValue (r : Nat → Nat) : Value R S → Value R S
    | .ref r => .ref r
    | .recvar s => .recvar s
    | .var i => .var (r i)
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (renameComp r m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (renameValue r v)
    | .both v => .both (renameValue r v)
    | .top v => .top (renameValue r v)
    | .view v o => .view (renameValue r v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (renameComp (Original.up r) body) (renameAdapter r consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (renameValue r f) (renameAdapter r input) (renameAdapter r output)
  def renameComp (r : Nat → Nat) : Comp R S → Comp R S
    | .ret v => .ret (renameValue r v)
    | .force v => .force (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (renameValue r v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (renameValue r v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (renameComp r m) (renameComp (Original.up r) n)
    | .unionCase v l right => .unionCase (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) l) (renameComp (Original.up r) right)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (renameComp r body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (renameComp r body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (renameValue r f) (renameValue r a)
    | .handle h m => .handle (renameHandler r h) (renameComp r m)
    | .tryValue h v arms => .tryValue (renameHandler r h) (renameValue r v) (renameValueArms r arms)
    | .waitValue h v arms attempt => .waitValue (renameHandler r h) (renameValue r v)
        (renameValueArms r arms) (renameComp r attempt)
    | .tryOperation h op p k arms => .tryOperation (renameHandler r h) op (renameValue r p)
        (renameComp (Original.up r) k) (renameOperationArms r arms)
    | .waitOperation h op p k arms attempt => .waitOperation (renameHandler r h) op (renameValue r p)
        (renameComp (Original.up r) k) (renameOperationArms r arms) (renameComp r attempt)
  def renameHandler (r : Nat → Nat) : Handler R S → Handler R S
    | .mk id a b vs os => .mk id a b (renameValueArms r vs) (renameOperationArms r os)
  def renameValueArms (r : Nat → Nat) : ValueArms R S → ValueArms R S
    | .nil => .nil
    | .cons body rest => .cons (renameComp (Original.up r) body) (renameValueArms r rest)
  def renameOperationArms (r : Nat → Nat) : OperationArms R S → OperationArms R S
    | .nil => .nil
    | .cons op eligible body rest => .cons op eligible (renameComp (Original.up (Original.up r)) body)
        (renameOperationArms r rest)
  def renameAdapter (r : Nat → Nat) : Adapter R S → Adapter R S
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (renameComp (Original.up r) body) paths views
end

def lift (s : Nat → Value R S) : Nat → Value R S
  | 0 => .var 0
  | n+1 => renameValue Nat.succ (s n)

mutual
  def substValue (s : Nat → Value R S) : Value R S → Value R S
    | .ref r => .ref r
    | .recvar s => .recvar s
    | .var i => s i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (substComp s m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (substValue s v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (substValue s v)
    | .both v => .both (substValue s v)
    | .top v => .top (substValue s v)
    | .view v o => .view (substValue s v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (substComp (lift s) body) (substAdapter s consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (substValue s f) (substAdapter s input) (substAdapter s output)
  def substComp (s : Nat → Value R S) : Comp R S → Comp R S
    | .ret v => .ret (substValue s v)
    | .force v => .force (substValue s v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (substValue s v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (substValue s v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (substValue s v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (substComp s m) (substComp (lift s) n)
    | .unionCase v l r => .unionCase (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) l) (substComp (lift s) r)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (substComp s body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (substComp s body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (substValue s f) (substValue s a)
    | .handle h m => .handle (substHandler s h) (substComp s m)
    | .tryValue h v arms => .tryValue (substHandler s h) (substValue s v) (substValueArms s arms)
    | .waitValue h v arms attempt => .waitValue (substHandler s h) (substValue s v)
        (substValueArms s arms) (substComp s attempt)
    | .tryOperation h op p k arms => .tryOperation (substHandler s h) op (substValue s p)
        (substComp (lift s) k) (substOperationArms s arms)
    | .waitOperation h op p k arms attempt => .waitOperation (substHandler s h) op (substValue s p)
        (substComp (lift s) k) (substOperationArms s arms) (substComp s attempt)
  def substHandler (s : Nat → Value R S) : Handler R S → Handler R S
    | .mk id a b vs os => .mk id a b (substValueArms s vs) (substOperationArms s os)
  def substValueArms (s : Nat → Value R S) : ValueArms R S → ValueArms R S
    | .nil => .nil
    | .cons body rest => .cons (substComp (lift s) body) (substValueArms s rest)
  def substOperationArms (s : Nat → Value R S) : OperationArms R S → OperationArms R S
    | .nil => .nil
    | .cons op eligible body rest => .cons op eligible (substComp (lift (lift s)) body)
        (substOperationArms s rest)
  def substAdapter (s : Nat → Value R S) : Adapter R S → Adapter R S
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (substComp (lift s) body) paths views
end

def RenamingTyped (env target : Context) (r : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → target (r i) = some a

theorem up_typed (h : RenamingTyped env target r) (a : Ty) :
    RenamingTyped (extend env a) (extend target a) (Original.up r) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero => exact hi
  | succ i => exact h i b hi

mutual
  theorem renameValue_typed (h : ValueTyped xi nu env v a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      ValueTyped xi nu target (renameValue r v) a := by
    cases h with
    | ref r => exact .ref r
    | recvar s => exact .recvar s
    | var h => exact .var (ht _ _ h)
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameAdapter_typed i ht) (renameAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem renameComp_typed (h : CompTyped xi nu env m a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      CompTyped xi nu target (renameComp r m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (renameComp_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (renameValue_typed h ht)
          (renameComp_typed l (up_typed ht _)) (renameComp_typed r (up_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
    | handle hh hm => exact .handle (renameHandler_typed hh ht) (renameComp_typed hm ht)
    | tryValue hh hv hs => exact .tryValue (renameHandler_typed hh ht) (renameValue_typed hv ht) (renameValueArms_typed hs ht)
    | waitValue hh hv hs hm => exact .waitValue (renameHandler_typed hh ht) (renameValue_typed hv ht) (renameValueArms_typed hs ht) (renameComp_typed hm ht)
    | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => exact .tryOperation (renameHandler_typed hh ht) (renameValue_typed hp ht) (renameComp_typed hk (up_typed ht _)) (renameOperationArms_typed hs ht)
    | waitOperation hh hp hk hs hm => exact .waitOperation (renameHandler_typed hh ht) (renameValue_typed hp ht) (renameComp_typed hk (up_typed ht _)) (renameOperationArms_typed hs ht) (renameComp_typed hm ht)
  theorem renameHandler_typed (h : HandlerTyped xi nu env handler a b) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      HandlerTyped xi nu target (renameHandler r handler) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk hv ho => exact .mk (renameValueArms_typed hv ht) (renameOperationArms_typed ho ht)
  theorem renameValueArms_typed (h : ValueArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      ValueArmsTyped xi nu target (renameValueArms r arms) a b := by
    cases h with
    | nil => exact .nil
    | cons hb hr => exact .cons (renameComp_typed hb (up_typed ht _)) (renameValueArms_typed hr ht)
  theorem renameOperationArms_typed (h : OperationArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      OperationArmsTyped xi nu target (renameOperationArms r arms) a b := by
    cases h with
    | nil => exact .nil
    | cons hb hr => exact .cons (renameComp_typed hb (up_typed (up_typed ht _) _)) (renameOperationArms_typed hr ht)
  theorem renameAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi nu env adapter a b) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      AdapterTyped xi nu target (renameAdapter r adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _))
end

def SubstitutionTyped (xi : R → Ty) (nu : S → Ty) (env target : Context) (s : Nat → Value R S) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → ValueTyped xi nu target (s i) a

theorem lift_typed (h : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) (a : Ty) :
    SubstitutionTyped xi nu (extend env a) (extend target a) (lift s) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst b
      exact .var rfl
  | succ i => exact renameValue_typed (h i b hi) (fun _ _ h => h)

mutual
  theorem substValue_typed (h : ValueTyped xi nu env v a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      ValueTyped xi nu target (substValue s v) a := by
    cases h with
    | ref r => exact .ref r
    | recvar s => exact .recvar s
    | var h => exact ht _ _ h
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (substComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (substValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (substValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (substValue_typed h ht) (substAdapter_typed i ht) (substAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem substComp_typed (h : CompTyped xi nu env m a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      CompTyped xi nu target (substComp s m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (substValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (substValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (substComp_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (substValue_typed h ht)
          (substComp_typed l (lift_typed ht _)) (substComp_typed r (lift_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (substComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (substComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (substValue_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
    | handle hh hm => exact .handle (substHandler_typed hh ht) (substComp_typed hm ht)
    | tryValue hh hv hs => exact .tryValue (substHandler_typed hh ht) (substValue_typed hv ht) (substValueArms_typed hs ht)
    | waitValue hh hv hs hm => exact .waitValue (substHandler_typed hh ht) (substValue_typed hv ht) (substValueArms_typed hs ht) (substComp_typed hm ht)
    | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => exact .tryOperation (substHandler_typed hh ht) (substValue_typed hp ht) (substComp_typed hk (lift_typed ht _)) (substOperationArms_typed hs ht)
    | waitOperation hh hp hk hs hm => exact .waitOperation (substHandler_typed hh ht) (substValue_typed hp ht) (substComp_typed hk (lift_typed ht _)) (substOperationArms_typed hs ht) (substComp_typed hm ht)
  theorem substHandler_typed (h : HandlerTyped xi nu env handler a b) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      HandlerTyped xi nu target (substHandler s handler) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk hv ho => exact .mk (substValueArms_typed hv ht) (substOperationArms_typed ho ht)
  theorem substValueArms_typed (h : ValueArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      ValueArmsTyped xi nu target (substValueArms s arms) a b := by
    cases h with
    | nil => exact .nil
    | cons hb hr => exact .cons (substComp_typed hb (lift_typed ht _)) (substValueArms_typed hr ht)
  theorem substOperationArms_typed (h : OperationArmsTyped xi nu env arms a b) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      OperationArmsTyped xi nu target (substOperationArms s arms) a b := by
    cases h with
    | nil => exact .nil
    | cons hb hr => exact .cons (substComp_typed hb (lift_typed (lift_typed ht _) _)) (substOperationArms_typed hr ht)
  theorem substAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi nu env adapter a b) (ht : SubstitutionTyped xi nu env target s) :
      AdapterTyped xi nu target (substAdapter s adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _))
end

def single (v : Value R S) : Nat → Value R S
  | 0 => v
  | n+1 => .var n

theorem substitute_top (hb : CompTyped xi nu (extend env a) body b) (hv : ValueTyped xi nu env v a) :
    CompTyped xi nu env (substComp (single v) body) b := by
  apply substComp_typed hb
  intro i t hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst t
      exact hv
  | succ i => exact .var hi



def emptyTy : Empty → Ty := Empty.elim


theorem lift_cancel (r : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat → Value R S)
    (h : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) :
    ∀ i, lift s (Original.up r i) = .var i := by
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i => simp only [Original.up, lift, h, renameValue]

mutual
  theorem value_rename_cancel (v : Value R S) (r : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat → Value R S)
      (hcancel : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) : substValue s (renameValue r v) = v := by
    cases v with
    | ref r => rfl
    | recvar s => rfl
    | var i => exact hcancel i
    | unit  => rfl
    | bool v => rfl
    | int v => rfl
    | floatBits v => rfl
    | string v => rfl
    | bytes v => rfl
    | path v => rfl
    | char v => rfl
    | delay m => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel m r s hcancel]
    | inLeft v => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | inRight v => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | both v => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | top v => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | view v o => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel body (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel), adapter_rename_cancel consumer r s hcancel]
    | wrap f input output => 
        simp only [renameValue, substValue]
        rw [value_rename_cancel f r s hcancel, adapter_rename_cancel input r s hcancel, adapter_rename_cancel output r s hcancel]
  theorem comp_rename_cancel (v : Comp R S) (r : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat → Value R S)
      (hcancel : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) : substComp s (renameComp r v) = v := by
    cases v with
    | ret v => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | force v => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | chooseLeft v => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | chooseRight v => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | absurd v => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel]
    | bind m n => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel m r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel n (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel)]
    | unionCase v l right => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel l (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel), comp_rename_cancel right (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel)]
    | scope owner body => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel body r s hcancel]
    | expose ev rv body => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel body r s hcancel]
    | request op v k => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel k (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel)]
    | fail reason => rfl
    | dynamicCall f a => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [value_rename_cancel f r s hcancel, value_rename_cancel a r s hcancel]
    | handle h m => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [handler_rename_cancel h r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel m r s hcancel]
    | tryValue h v arms => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [handler_rename_cancel h r s hcancel, value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel, valueArms_rename_cancel arms r s hcancel]
    | waitValue h v arms attempt => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [handler_rename_cancel h r s hcancel, value_rename_cancel v r s hcancel, valueArms_rename_cancel arms r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel attempt r s hcancel]
    | tryOperation h op p k arms => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [handler_rename_cancel h r s hcancel, value_rename_cancel p r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel k (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel), operationArms_rename_cancel arms r s hcancel]
    | waitOperation h op p k arms attempt => 
        simp only [renameComp, substComp]
        rw [handler_rename_cancel h r s hcancel, value_rename_cancel p r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel k (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel), operationArms_rename_cancel arms r s hcancel, comp_rename_cancel attempt r s hcancel]
  theorem handler_rename_cancel (v : Handler R S) (r : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat → Value R S)
      (hcancel : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) : substHandler s (renameHandler r v) = v := by
    cases v with
    | mk id a b vs os => 
        simp only [renameHandler, substHandler]
        rw [valueArms_rename_cancel vs r s hcancel, operationArms_rename_cancel os r s hcancel]
  theorem valueArms_rename_cancel (v : ValueArms R S) (r : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat → Value R S)
      (hcancel : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) : substValueArms s (renameValueArms r v) = v := by
    cases v with
    | nil  => rfl
    | cons body rest => 
        simp only [renameValueArms, substValueArms]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel body (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel), valueArms_rename_cancel rest r s hcancel]
  theorem operationArms_rename_cancel (v : OperationArms R S) (r : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat → Value R S)
      (hcancel : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) : substOperationArms s (renameOperationArms r v) = v := by
    cases v with
    | nil  => rfl
    | cons op eligible body rest => 
        simp only [renameOperationArms, substOperationArms]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel body (Original.up (Original.up r)) (lift (lift s)) (lift_cancel (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel)), operationArms_rename_cancel rest r s hcancel]
  theorem adapter_rename_cancel (v : Adapter R S) (r : Nat → Nat) (s : Nat → Value R S)
      (hcancel : ∀ i, s (r i) = .var i) : substAdapter s (renameAdapter r v) = v := by
    cases v with
    | mk a b body paths views => 
        simp only [renameAdapter, substAdapter]
        rw [comp_rename_cancel body (Original.up r) (lift s) (lift_cancel r s hcancel)]
end

end YulangClosure.HandlerGraph

# Combined higher-order handlers and guarded value graphs

Status: candidate research construction, pending primary elaboration and fresh
independent review. Production authority: none. Parent:
`HO-HANDLER-GRAPH-COMPOSITION-1`, paper guarded values 180–196, recursive
allocation 980–993, shallow handlers 399–456, local preservation 1069–1088,
and safety 1139–1159. The original paper theorem and Simple-sub A/B, F1/FK1
quantifiers remain OPEN.

Contract: `HANDLER-GRAPH-EXTENSION-THEORY-20261025/r1`, SHA-256
`b0b9f069dc8f08ed5f87a26b37d98df404e5a9dd4f0628244adc79095634a9e8`.
Author: `/root/handler_graph_composition_astra_r1`; primary `/root` supplied the
wait-result reference coverage reminder and cancellation-hypothesis shadowing
repair observation. Neither is eligible to independently certify this packet.
Requested model/effort: `gpt-6-astra/medium`; observed model/effort: UNKNOWN.
No descendants, additional dependencies, scratch paths, compiler changes or
production semantic decisions.

## Original claim and candidate application

The parent needs one actual syntax and execution relation supporting both
accepted languages simultaneously. Separate safety theorems were insufficient:
the old graph machine suspends requests/failures inside finite evaluation
contexts, while the old handler machine propagates them to the root. The new
candidate constructs the shared grammar, derives finite observations from the
actual graph typing and guard, and proves preservation and root-only progress
for every finite raw internal prefix. It then connects both old machines and
consumes the actual old recursive allocation supplier under an independently
typed combined handler.

`HandlerGraphSyntax` has six mutually recursive sorts: Value, Comp, Adapter,
Handler, ValueArms and OperationArms. Every accepted Graph and Handler
constructor is represented structurally. References, recursive names and local
indices remain distinct. Lambda bodies, outer result consumers, adapter input
bodies, request response binders, value-arm binders and both operation-arm
binders contain the full combined language. The existing Ty, modes, operation
instances, literal payloads and all metadata fields are reused unchanged.
Extrinsic typing and structural renaming/substitution cover every constructor.
The six cancellation lemmas justify substitution after binder insertion; they
are applied to the actual context resumption equation.

`HandlerGraphEmbedding` recursively embeds both old languages in arbitrary
typing contexts. Its renaming/substitution commutation lemmas are consumed by
actual old-step simulation. `liftGraph_typed` derives new node typing from old
node derivations. `liftGraph_projection` proves exact equality of the guard
projections, so `liftGraph_guard` transports the existing guard. Projected unit
is only a stopping token; it supplies neither typing nor a canonical value.

`HandlerGraphSafety` derives `ObservedTyped` from actual node typing and the
transparent successor rank. Intersection has two separate premises, top retains
its underlying type witness, and wrap retains different inner and outer callable
types and both adapters. No typing premise occurs in `Step`. Lookup is explicit
for force, union/intersection elimination, absurd and dynamic call, and also for
references returned as No/Yes carriers inside both kinds of wait. The machine
retains all shallow-handler trial, ordering, skipping, nesting, propagation and
restoration rules. The selected arm receives the original K:Q→A; only exhaustion
constructs the shifted handler around K, yielding H K:Q→B. Eligibility remains
raw Bool data, with no native permission adequacy claim. `preservation` assumes
actual closed graph typing; `closed_progress` additionally consumes the guard.
`finite_prefix_safety` quantifies over every raw finite internal trace.

`HandlerGraphCorrespondence.graph_step` and `handler_step` map every old raw
step, actual event and complete lambda/wrap entry plan. Their finite trace
versions preserve event order. `propagate_graph_request` and
`propagate_graph_failure` construct finite sequences through every old context;
`graph_suspended_root` consumes the old full suspension decomposition.
`graph_request_correspondence` retains the identical full operation instance and
payload and derives the resulting continuation typing from the old contextual
computation typing plus actual propagation. `graph_resume_equation` states that
substituting any combined response into the propagated continuation equals the
same outer context around the original response-substituted K.
`old_graph_resume_equation` further identifies this with the embedding of the
old resumed contextual computation. `graph_resumption_safety` applies the
supplier to arbitrary independently typed responses and every subsequent
internal prefix, without consuming the saved code or imposing linear use.

`source_rec_under_handler` calls the exact accepted `source_rec_allocation`,
lifts its actual allocated graph and closed body, derives combined typing and
guard, and establishes every finite prefix under an independently typed combined
handler. Its only fresh guard premise is the old actual `FreshNoCycle`; no new
fresh-node typing or rank supplier is introduced. `SourceExample` starts with
an empty old graph, closes a genuinely recursive source lambda with a request
and self-call in the response continuation, gives the exact allocated-node
equation, and executes its request through handler selection. `Examples` also
executes a recursive graph lambda through a graph-backed attempt/wait result,
and a nested request followed by restoration, reference lookup and Yes return.
The examples supplement the quantified statements.

## Reused evidence and exact open boundaries

The accepted Handler syntax/substitution/trial construction and Graph
syntax/allocation/observation construction are reused within their actual finite
constructor domains. Their independent safety conclusions were not assumed to
compose. The previous contextual graph terminal convention is not reused as
combined root progress. Literal readback, template replay, closure environments
and historical Call proofs are not treated as universal higher-order native
readback or metadata suppliers. No failed or withdrawn Simple-sub bypass is
restored. No residual, provider, witness or foreign-continuation lineage is
identified by this construction.

The original paper remains OPEN for omitted μ/type-changing roll,
polymorphism, mapop, primitive and other forms. This packet does not allocate
arbitrary new combined handler-valued RHS simultaneously: it embeds the actual
accepted old RHS allocation and permits independently typed combined handlers
around its body. Combined external responses carrying fresh graph extensions
remain a future integration with the independent extension lane; no cross-lane
import is assumed. Live metadata, grants, activation/owner freshening and full
source/native correspondence remain OPEN. The internal safety candidate does
not imply F1, FK1, inference soundness/principality or production adoption.

## Source/native audit and mutual TODOs

`tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/machine.rs` was inspected at these
actual owners:

- `begin_local` (2500) allocates an empty cell, extends recursive environments
  before evaluating the initializer, and pushes `Frame::Local`. The return
  branch (1498) installs the received value into that cell. The proof's immutable
  finite graph allocation is not an established readback of every such native
  execution or arbitrary initializer.
- `propagate_request` (2081) examines the installed CatchReturn delimiter,
  validates its installation, resolves declarations and demands a local Grant
  unless the closed primitive certificate applies. A Bool arm flag is not a
  proof that these live checks succeed.
- `TemplateNode::ForwardHandler` replay (1989) resolves and validates the owner,
  allocates a fresh handler occurrence, and installs CatchReturn. The finite
  syntax retains identity/metadata but proves no activation freshness or owner
  adequacy theorem.
- `Frame::CatchReturn` (1097) returns the incoming value when no value arm exists.
  The accepted paper empty value trial fails with MatchFailure. Existing
  `HO-HANDLER-VALUE-EMPTY-1` remains OPEN; no identity-arm normalization or runtime
  defect verdict is inferred.

`NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE`: these owners need the missing source/readback and semantic
premises before any dependent production patch. No compiler edit is proposed.
The following requests specify evidence, not permission to write or run:

| Request | Owner / first missing evidence | Exact falsifier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HG-ALLOC-READBACK-1 | Luna/native source intake; map actual begin_local/Frame::Local cells, captured environments and accepted recursive RHS code to the immutable allocation and prove all reachable supplier premises | An accepted recursive initializer/capture path has no typed graph readback, or exposes an unfilled cell along a claimed represented path |
| HG-HANDLER-METADATA-1 | Luna/metadata source intake; supply full operation-instance, Grant, installation and owner-freshening correspondence for propagate_request and ForwardHandler | A claimed represented typed execution returns HandlerEvidence or violates restored owner/activation identity despite the proposed supplier premises |
| HG-EMPTY-VALUES-1 | Existing HO-HANDLER-VALUE-EMPTY-1 owner; resolve native no-arm return versus paper MatchFailure under approved semantics | Direct mapping of an empty value-arm CatchReturn yields Ret natively and Fail formally |
| HG-EXTENSION-INTEGRATION-1 | Luna future proof intake; transport the independent extension construction through the complete six-sort grammar and saved combined waits | An old saved handler-bearing continuation loses typing or changes its old node/operation identity after an admitted fresh extension |

These requests preserve original owners and quantifiers. No local frame action
is offered as a replacement for the independently quantified foreign continuation
obligation. Primary elaboration and fresh independent review are the immediate

design_note_text:
# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain
machine.rs `Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`,
`Machine::extend`, closure/Callee branches and receiving.rs lambda schema
construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

## Intake and checks

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`
invocation failed because the executable was absent; the generation was then
performed with python3. This was a file-writing failure before any write, not a
failed proof check. Primary owns bounded elaboration, public signature/axiom
inspection, distinguishing examples, repairs after author STOP and fresh
independent review. Author/coauthor cannot independently certify this candidate.
Only the four exact leased files were created; there are no scratch paths,
background processes, descendants, compiler changes or Git operations.

import YulangClosure.HandlerGraphSyntax

namespace YulangClosure.HandlerGraph
open HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend OperationInstance ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate PathCorrespondence)
variable {R S : Type} {xi : R → Ty} {nu : S → Ty}

mutual
  def graphValue : HigherOrderGraph.Value R S → Value R S
    | .ref r => .ref r
    | .recvar s => .recvar s
    | .var i => .var i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v

abbrev Graph (R : Type) := R → Value R Empty

def WellTyped (graph : Graph R) (xi : R → Ty) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext (graph r) (xi r)

/-- Only genuine data introductions, lambda and delay stop transparent
inspection. Intersection/top evidence, views, and callable adapter wrappers
do not turn an alias cycle into a constructed value. Local variables cannot
occur at the head of a well-typed closed graph node. -/
def frontier : Value R S → Option (Sum R S)
  | .ref r => some (.inl r)
  | .recvar s => some (.inr s)
  | .both v | .top v | .view v _ | .wrap v _ _ => frontier v
  | _ => none

def nextValue (v : Value R Empty) : Option R :=
  (frontier v).map (Sum.elim id Empty.elim)

/-- Unit is ONLY a terminal token in the untyped guard projection. It is
never the encoding, type, or canonical form of the higher-order value. -/
def projectNode (v : Value R Empty) : GuardedValueGraph.Node R :=
  match nextValue v with
  | none => .unit
  | some r => .alias r

def projectGraph (graph : Graph R) : GuardedValueGraph.Graph R :=
  fun r => projectNode (graph r)

theorem projectNode_next (v : Value R Empty) :
    (projectNode v).next = nextValue v := by
  unfold projectNode
  cases nextValue v <;> rfl

theorem projection_edge (graph : Graph R) (r s : R) :
    (projectGraph graph r).next = some s ↔ nextValue (graph r) = some s := by
  rw [projectGraph, projectNode_next]


def liftGraph (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R) : Graph R := fun r => graphValue (g r)

theorem liftGraph_typed (h : HigherOrderGraph.WellTyped g xi) : WellTyped (liftGraph g) xi :=
  fun r => graphValue_typed (h r)

theorem graph_frontier (v : HigherOrderGraph.Value R S) :
    frontier (graphValue v) = HigherOrderGraph.frontier v := by
  cases v with
  | both v => exact graph_frontier v
  | top v => exact graph_frontier v
  | view v o => exact graph_frontier v
  | wrap v i o => exact graph_frontier v
  | ref r => rfl
  | recvar s => rfl
  | var i => rfl
  | unit => rfl
  | bool v => rfl
  | int v => rfl
  | floatBits v => rfl
  | string v => rfl
  | bytes v => rfl
  | path v => rfl
  | char v => rfl
  | delay m => rfl
  | inLeft v => rfl
  | inRight v => rfl
  | lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer => rfl

theorem graph_next (v : HigherOrderGraph.Value R Empty) :
    nextValue (graphValue v) = HigherOrderGraph.nextValue v := by
  unfold nextValue HigherOrderGraph.nextValue
  rw [graph_frontier]

theorem liftGraph_projection (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R) :
    projectGraph (liftGraph g) = HigherOrderGraph.projectGraph g := by
  funext r
  simp only [projectGraph, liftGraph, projectNode, graph_next,
    HigherOrderGraph.projectGraph, HigherOrderGraph.projectNode]

def liftGraph_guard (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R)
    (h : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (HigherOrderGraph.projectGraph g)) :
    GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph (liftGraph g)) :=
  (liftGraph_projection g).symm ▸ h

theorem graph_lift_compat {s : Nat → HigherOrderGraph.Value R S} {t : Nat → Value R S}
    (hs : ∀ i, graphValue (s i) = t i) :
    ∀ i, graphValue (HigherOrderGraph.lift s i) = lift t i := by
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i =>
      simp only [HigherOrderGraph.lift, lift, graphValue_rename, hs]

  theorem graphValue_subst (v : HigherOrderGraph.Value R S) (s : Nat → HigherOrderGraph.Value R S) (t : Nat → Value R S)

      graphValue (HigherOrderGraph.substValue s v) = substValue t (graphValue v) := by
    cases v with
    | ref r => rfl
    | recvar s => rfl

    | floatBits v => rfl

    | bytes v => rfl
    | path v => rfl
    | char v => rfl
    | delay m =>

        rw [graphComp_subst m s t hs]
    | inLeft v => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substValue, graphValue, substValue]
        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs]
    | inRight v => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substValue, graphValue, substValue]
        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs]
    | both v => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substValue, graphValue, substValue]

        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs]
    | view v o => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substValue, graphValue, substValue]
        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs]
    | lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substValue, graphValue, substValue]
        rw [graphComp_subst body (HigherOrderGraph.lift s) (lift t) (graph_lift_compat hs), graphAdapter_subst consumer s t hs]
    | wrap f input output => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substValue, graphValue, substValue]
        rw [graphValue_subst f s t hs, graphAdapter_subst input s t hs, graphAdapter_subst output s t hs]
  theorem graphComp_subst (v : HigherOrderGraph.Comp R S) (s : Nat → HigherOrderGraph.Value R S) (t : Nat → Value R S)
      (hs : ∀ i, graphValue (s i) = t i) :
      graphComp (HigherOrderGraph.substComp s v) = substComp t (graphComp v) := by
    cases v with
    | ret v => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substComp, graphComp, substComp]
        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs]
    | force v => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substComp, graphComp, substComp]
        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs]
    | chooseLeft v => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substComp, graphComp, substComp]

    | chooseRight v =>

    | absurd v =>

        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs]
    | bind m n => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substComp, graphComp, substComp]
        rw [graphComp_subst m s t hs, graphComp_subst n (HigherOrderGraph.lift s) (lift t) (graph_lift_compat hs)]
    | unionCase v l right => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substComp, graphComp, substComp]
        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs, graphComp_subst l (HigherOrderGraph.lift s) (lift t) (graph_lift_compat hs), graphComp_subst right (HigherOrderGraph.lift s) (lift t) (graph_lift_compat hs)]
    | scope owner body => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substComp, graphComp, substComp]
        rw [graphComp_subst body s t hs]
    | expose ev rv body =>

    | request op v k =>

        rw [graphValue_subst v s t hs, graphComp_subst k (HigherOrderGraph.lift s) (lift t) (graph_lift_compat hs)]
    | fail reason => rfl
    | dynamicCall f a => 
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.substComp, graphComp, substComp]
        rw [graphValue_subst f s t hs, graphValue_subst a s t hs]

    | chooseRight v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerValue_rename r v]
    | absurd v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerValue_rename r v]
    | bind m n => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerComp_rename r m, handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) n]
    | unionCase v l right => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerValue_rename r v, handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) l, handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) right]
    | scope owner body => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerComp_rename r body]
    | expose ev rv body => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerComp_rename r body]
    | request op v k => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerValue_rename r v, handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) k]
    | fail reason => rfl
    | dynamicCall f a => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerValue_rename r f, handlerValue_rename r a]
    | handle h m => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_rename r h, handlerComp_rename r m]
    | tryValue h v arms => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_rename r h, handlerValue_rename r v, handlerValueArms_rename r arms]
    | waitValue h v arms attempt => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_rename r h, handlerValue_rename r v, handlerValueArms_rename r arms, handlerComp_rename r attempt]
    | tryOperation h op p k arms => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_rename r h, handlerValue_rename r p, handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) k, handlerOperationArms_rename r arms]
    | waitOperation h op p k arms attempt => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameComp, handlerComp, renameComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_rename r h, handlerValue_rename r p, handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) k, handlerOperationArms_rename r arms, handlerComp_rename r attempt]
  theorem handlerHandler_rename (r : Nat → Nat) (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Handler) :
      handlerHandler (HigherOrder.Handler.renameHandler r v) = renameHandler r (handlerHandler (R := R) (S := S) v) := by
    cases v with
    | mk id a b vs os => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameHandler, handlerHandler, renameHandler]
        rw [handlerValueArms_rename r vs, handlerOperationArms_rename r os]
  theorem handlerValueArms_rename (r : Nat → Nat) (v : HigherOrder.Handler.ValueArms) :
      handlerValueArms (HigherOrder.Handler.renameValueArms r v) = renameValueArms r (handlerValueArms (R := R) (S := S) v) := by
    cases v with
    | nil  => rfl
    | cons body rest => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameValueArms, handlerValueArms, renameValueArms]
        rw [handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) body, handlerValueArms_rename r rest]
  theorem handlerOperationArms_rename (r : Nat → Nat) (v : HigherOrder.Handler.OperationArms) :
      handlerOperationArms (HigherOrder.Handler.renameOperationArms r v) = renameOperationArms r (handlerOperationArms (R := R) (S := S) v) := by
    cases v with
    | nil  => rfl
    | cons op eligible body rest => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameOperationArms, handlerOperationArms, renameOperationArms]
        rw [handlerComp_rename (Original.up (Original.up r)) body, handlerOperationArms_rename r rest]
  theorem handlerAdapter_rename (r : Nat → Nat) (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Adapter) :
      handlerAdapter (HigherOrder.Handler.renameAdapter r v) = renameAdapter r (handlerAdapter (R := R) (S := S) v) := by
    cases v with
    | mk a b body paths views => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.renameAdapter, handlerAdapter, renameAdapter]
        rw [handlerComp_rename (Original.up r) body]
end

theorem handler_lift_compat {s : Nat → HigherOrder.Handler.Value} {t : Nat → Value R S}
    (hs : ∀ i, handlerValue (s i) = t i) :
    ∀ i, handlerValue (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s i) = lift t i := by
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i =>
      simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.lift, lift, handlerValue_rename, hs]

mutual
  theorem handlerValue_subst (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (s : Nat → HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (t : Nat → Value R S)
      (hs : ∀ i, handlerValue (s i) = t i) :
      handlerValue (HigherOrder.Handler.substValue s v) = substValue t (handlerValue v) := by
    cases v with
    | var i => exact hs i
    | unit  => rfl
    | bool v => rfl
    | int v => rfl
    | floatBits v => rfl
    | string v => rfl
    | bytes v => rfl
    | path v => rfl
    | char v => rfl
    | delay m => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerComp_subst m s t hs]
    | inLeft v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | inRight v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | both v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | top v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | view v o => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerComp_subst body (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs), handlerAdapter_subst consumer s t hs]
    | wrap f input output => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValue, handlerValue, substValue]
        rw [handlerValue_subst f s t hs, handlerAdapter_subst input s t hs, handlerAdapter_subst output s t hs]
  theorem handlerComp_subst (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Comp) (s : Nat → HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (t : Nat → Value R S)
      (hs : ∀ i, handlerValue (s i) = t i) :
      handlerComp (HigherOrder.Handler.substComp s v) = substComp t (handlerComp v) := by
    cases v with
    | ret v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | force v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | chooseLeft v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | chooseRight v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | absurd v => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs]
    | bind m n => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerComp_subst m s t hs, handlerComp_subst n (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs)]
    | unionCase v l right => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs, handlerComp_subst l (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs), handlerComp_subst right (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs)]
    | scope owner body => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerComp_subst body s t hs]
    | expose ev rv body => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerComp_subst body s t hs]
    | request op v k => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst v s t hs, handlerComp_subst k (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs)]
    | fail reason => rfl
    | dynamicCall f a => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerValue_subst f s t hs, handlerValue_subst a s t hs]
    | handle h m => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_subst h s t hs, handlerComp_subst m s t hs]
    | tryValue h v arms => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_subst h s t hs, handlerValue_subst v s t hs, handlerValueArms_subst arms s t hs]
    | waitValue h v arms attempt => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_subst h s t hs, handlerValue_subst v s t hs, handlerValueArms_subst arms s t hs, handlerComp_subst attempt s t hs]
    | tryOperation h op p k arms => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_subst h s t hs, handlerValue_subst p s t hs, handlerComp_subst k (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs), handlerOperationArms_subst arms s t hs]
    | waitOperation h op p k arms attempt => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substComp, handlerComp, substComp]
        rw [handlerHandler_subst h s t hs, handlerValue_subst p s t hs, handlerComp_subst k (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs), handlerOperationArms_subst arms s t hs, handlerComp_subst attempt s t hs]
  theorem handlerHandler_subst (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Handler) (s : Nat → HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (t : Nat → Value R S)
      (hs : ∀ i, handlerValue (s i) = t i) :
      handlerHandler (HigherOrder.Handler.substHandler s v) = substHandler t (handlerHandler v) := by
    cases v with
    | mk id a b vs os => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substHandler, handlerHandler, substHandler]
        rw [handlerValueArms_subst vs s t hs, handlerOperationArms_subst os s t hs]
  theorem handlerValueArms_subst (v : HigherOrder.Handler.ValueArms) (s : Nat → HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (t : Nat → Value R S)
      (hs : ∀ i, handlerValue (s i) = t i) :
      handlerValueArms (HigherOrder.Handler.substValueArms s v) = substValueArms t (handlerValueArms v) := by
    cases v with
    | nil  => rfl
    | cons body rest => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substValueArms, handlerValueArms, substValueArms]
        rw [handlerComp_subst body (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs), handlerValueArms_subst rest s t hs]
  theorem handlerOperationArms_subst (v : HigherOrder.Handler.OperationArms) (s : Nat → HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (t : Nat → Value R S)
      (hs : ∀ i, handlerValue (s i) = t i) :
      handlerOperationArms (HigherOrder.Handler.substOperationArms s v) = substOperationArms t (handlerOperationArms v) := by
    cases v with
    | nil  => rfl
    | cons op eligible body rest => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substOperationArms, handlerOperationArms, substOperationArms]
        rw [handlerComp_subst body (HigherOrder.Handler.lift (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s)) (lift (lift t)) (handler_lift_compat (handler_lift_compat hs)), handlerOperationArms_subst rest s t hs]
  theorem handlerAdapter_subst (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Adapter) (s : Nat → HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (t : Nat → Value R S)
      (hs : ∀ i, handlerValue (s i) = t i) :
      handlerAdapter (HigherOrder.Handler.substAdapter s v) = substAdapter t (handlerAdapter v) := by
    cases v with
    | mk a b body paths views => 
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.substAdapter, handlerAdapter, substAdapter]
        rw [handlerComp_subst body (HigherOrder.Handler.lift s) (lift t) (handler_lift_compat hs)]
end

end YulangClosure.HandlerGraph

# Combined higher-order handlers and guarded value graphs

Status: candidate research construction, pending primary elaboration and fresh
independent review. Production authority: none. Parent:
`HO-HANDLER-GRAPH-COMPOSITION-1`, paper guarded values 180–196, recursive
allocation 980–993, shallow handlers 399–456, local preservation 1069–1088,
and safety 1139–1159. The original paper theorem and Simple-sub A/B, F1/FK1
quantifiers remain OPEN.

Contract: `HANDLER-GRAPH-EXTENSION-THEORY-20261025/r1`, SHA-256
`b0b9f069dc8f08ed5f87a26b37d98df404e5a9dd4f0628244adc79095634a9e8`.
Author: `/root/handler_graph_composition_astra_r1`; primary `/root` supplied the
wait-result reference coverage reminder and cancellation-hypothesis shadowing
repair observation. Neither is eligible to independently certify this packet.
Requested model/effort: `gpt-6-astra/medium`; observed model/effort: UNKNOWN.
No descendants, additional dependencies, scratch paths, compiler changes or
production semantic decisions.

## Original claim and candidate application

The parent needs one actual syntax and execution relation supporting both
accepted languages simultaneously. Separate safety theorems were insufficient:
the old graph machine suspends requests/failures inside finite evaluation
contexts, while the old handler machine propagates them to the root. The new
candidate constructs the shared grammar, derives finite observations from the
actual graph typing and guard, and proves preservation and root-only progress
for every finite raw internal prefix. It then connects both old machines and
consumes the actual old recursive allocation supplier under an independently
typed combined handler.

`HandlerGraphSyntax` has six mutually recursive sorts: Value, Comp, Adapter,
Handler, ValueArms and OperationArms. Every accepted Graph and Handler
constructor is represented structurally. References, recursive names and local
indices remain distinct. Lambda bodies, outer result consumers, adapter input
bodies, request response binders, value-arm binders and both operation-arm
binders contain the full combined language. The existing Ty, modes, operation
instances, literal payloads and all metadata fields are reused unchanged.
Extrinsic typing and structural renaming/substitution cover every constructor.
The six cancellation lemmas justify substitution after binder insertion; they
are applied to the actual context resumption equation.

`HandlerGraphEmbedding` recursively embeds both old languages in arbitrary
typing contexts. Its renaming/substitution commutation lemmas are consumed by
actual old-step simulation. `liftGraph_typed` derives new node typing from old
node derivations. `liftGraph_projection` proves exact equality of the guard
projections, so `liftGraph_guard` transports the existing guard. Projected unit
is only a stopping token; it supplies neither typing nor a canonical value.

`HandlerGraphSafety` derives `ObservedTyped` from actual node typing and the
transparent successor rank. Intersection has two separate premises, top retains
its underlying type witness, and wrap retains different inner and outer callable
types and both adapters. No typing premise occurs in `Step`. Lookup is explicit
for force, union/intersection elimination, absurd and dynamic call, and also for
references returned as No/Yes carriers inside both kinds of wait. The machine
retains all shallow-handler trial, ordering, skipping, nesting, propagation and
restoration rules. The selected arm receives the original K:Q→A; only exhaustion
constructs the shifted handler around K, yielding H K:Q→B. Eligibility remains
raw Bool data, with no native permission adequacy claim. `preservation` assumes
actual closed graph typing; `closed_progress` additionally consumes the guard.
`finite_prefix_safety` quantifies over every raw finite internal trace.

`HandlerGraphCorrespondence.graph_step` and `handler_step` map every old raw
step, actual event and complete lambda/wrap entry plan. Their finite trace
versions preserve event order. `propagate_graph_request` and
`propagate_graph_failure` construct finite sequences through every old context;
`graph_suspended_root` consumes the old full suspension decomposition.
`graph_request_correspondence` retains the identical full operation instance and
payload and derives the resulting continuation typing from the old contextual
computation typing plus actual propagation. `graph_resume_equation` states that
substituting any combined response into the propagated continuation equals the
same outer context around the original response-substituted K.
`old_graph_resume_equation` further identifies this with the embedding of the
old resumed contextual computation. `graph_resumption_safety` applies the
supplier to arbitrary independently typed responses and every subsequent
internal prefix, without consuming the saved code or imposing linear use.

`source_rec_under_handler` calls the exact accepted `source_rec_allocation`,
lifts its actual allocated graph and closed body, derives combined typing and
guard, and establishes every finite prefix under an independently typed combined
handler. Its only fresh guard premise is the old actual `FreshNoCycle`; no new
fresh-node typing or rank supplier is introduced. `SourceExample` starts with
an empty old graph, closes a genuinely recursive source lambda with a request
and self-call in the response continuation, gives the exact allocated-node
equation, and executes its request through handler selection. `Examples` also
executes a recursive graph lambda through a graph-backed attempt/wait result,
and a nested request followed by restoration, reference lookup and Yes return.
The examples supplement the quantified statements.

## Reused evidence and exact open boundaries

The accepted Handler syntax/substitution/trial construction and Graph
syntax/allocation/observation construction are reused within their actual finite
constructor domains. Their independent safety conclusions were not assumed to
compose. The previous contextual graph terminal convention is not reused as
combined root progress. Literal readback, template replay, closure environments
and historical Call proofs are not treated as universal higher-order native
readback or metadata suppliers. No failed or withdrawn Simple-sub bypass is
restored. No residual, provider, witness or foreign-continuation lineage is
identified by this construction.

The original paper remains OPEN for omitted μ/type-changing roll,
polymorphism, mapop, primitive and other forms. This packet does not allocate
arbitrary new combined handler-valued RHS simultaneously: it embeds the actual
accepted old RHS allocation and permits independently typed combined handlers
around its body. Combined external responses carrying fresh graph extensions
remain a future integration with the independent extension lane; no cross-lane
import is assumed. Live metadata, grants, activation/owner freshening and full
source/native correspondence remain OPEN. The internal safety candidate does
not imply F1, FK1, inference soundness/principality or production adoption.

## Source/native audit and mutual TODOs

`tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/machine.rs` was inspected at these
actual owners:

- `begin_local` (2500) allocates an empty cell, extends recursive environments
  before evaluating the initializer, and pushes `Frame::Local`. The return
  branch (1498) installs the received value into that cell. The proof's immutable
  finite graph allocation is not an established readback of every such native
  execution or arbitrary initializer.
- `propagate_request` (2081) examines the installed CatchReturn delimiter,
  validates its installation, resolves declarations and demands a local Grant
  unless the closed primitive certificate applies. A Bool arm flag is not a
  proof that these live checks succeed.
- `TemplateNode::ForwardHandler` replay (1989) resolves and validates the owner,
  allocates a fresh handler occurrence, and installs CatchReturn. The finite
  syntax retains identity/metadata but proves no activation freshness or owner
  adequacy theorem.
- `Frame::CatchReturn` (1097) returns the incoming value when no value arm exists.
  The accepted paper empty value trial fails with MatchFailure. Existing
  `HO-HANDLER-VALUE-EMPTY-1` remains OPEN; no identity-arm normalization or runtime
  defect verdict is inferred.

`NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE`: these owners need the missing source/readback and semantic
premises before any dependent production patch. No compiler edit is proposed.
The following requests specify evidence, not permission to write or run:

| Request | Owner / first missing evidence | Exact falsifier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HG-ALLOC-READBACK-1 | Luna/native source intake; map actual begin_local/Frame::Local cells, captured environments and accepted recursive RHS code to the immutable allocation and prove all reachable supplier premises | An accepted recursive initializer/capture path has no typed graph readback, or exposes an unfilled cell along a claimed represented path |
| HG-HANDLER-METADATA-1 | Luna/metadata source intake; supply full operation-instance, Grant, installation and owner-freshening correspondence for propagate_request and ForwardHandler | A claimed represented typed execution returns HandlerEvidence or violates restored owner/activation identity despite the proposed supplier premises |
| HG-EMPTY-VALUES-1 | Existing HO-HANDLER-VALUE-EMPTY-1 owner; resolve native no-arm return versus paper MatchFailure under approved semantics | Direct mapping of an empty value-arm CatchReturn yields Ret natively and Fail formally |
| HG-EXTENSION-INTEGRATION-1 | Luna future proof intake; transport the independent extension construction through the complete six-sort grammar and saved combined waits | An old saved handler-bearing continuation loses typing or changes its old node/operation identity after an admitted fresh extension |

These requests preserve original owners and quantifiers. No local frame action
is offered as a replacement for the independently quantified foreign continuation
obligation. Primary elaboration and fresh independent review are the immediate
next steps for this candidate, before any finite-domain theorem acceptance.

Baseline: `7ff6e74d4515099bdb13e1cbf20fc38257cb2e36`. All 121 exact contract

All other direct/transitive frozen dependencies retain their exact contract table
