import YulangClosure.HandlerGraphEmbedding

namespace YulangClosure.HandlerGraph
open HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend OperationInstance ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate PathCorrespondence)
variable {R : Type}

inductive ObservedTyped (graph : Graph R) (xi : R → Ty) : Value R Empty → Ty → Prop where
  | ref (r) : ObservedTyped graph xi (graph r) (xi r) → ObservedTyped graph xi (.ref r) (xi r)
  | unit : ObservedTyped graph xi .unit (.base .unit)
  | bool : ObservedTyped graph xi (.bool v) (.base .bool)
  | int : ObservedTyped graph xi (.int v) (.base .int)
  | floatBits : ObservedTyped graph xi (.floatBits v) (.base .float)
  | string : ObservedTyped graph xi (.string v) (.base .string)
  | bytes : ObservedTyped graph xi (.bytes v) (.base .bytes)
  | path : ObservedTyped graph xi (.path v) (.base .path)
  | char : ObservedTyped graph xi (.char v) (.base .char)
  | delay : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext body a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.delay body) (.thunk a)
  | inLeft : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.inLeft v) (.union a b)
  | inRight : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v b → ObservedTyped graph xi (.inRight v) (.union a b)
  | both : ObservedTyped graph xi v a → ObservedTyped graph xi v b →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.both v) (.intersection a b)
  | top : ObservedTyped graph xi v a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.top v) .top
  | view : ObservedTyped graph xi v a → ObservedTyped graph xi (.view v occurrence) a
  | lambdaValue : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext a) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.lambda .value receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
  | lambdaComputation : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext (.thunk a)) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.lambda .computation receipt a b r body consumer) (.callable a r)
  | wrap : ObservedTyped graph xi f (.callable a b) →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext input c a → AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext output b d →
      ObservedTyped graph xi (.wrap f input output) (.callable c d)

variable {graph : Graph R} {xi : R → Ty}

theorem ObservedTyped.typed (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v a) :
    ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a := by
  induction h with
  | ref r _ _ => exact .ref r
  | unit => exact .unit
  | bool => exact .bool
  | int => exact .int
  | floatBits => exact .floatBits
  | string => exact .string
  | bytes => exact .bytes
  | path => exact .path
  | char => exact .char
  | delay h => exact .delay h
  | inLeft h => exact .inLeft h
  | inRight h => exact .inRight h
  | both _ _ ih ik => exact .both ih ik
  | top _ ih => exact .top ih
  | view _ ih => exact .view ih
  | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue h k
  | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation h k
  | wrap _ i o ih => exact .wrap ih i o

/-- Structural descent handles arbitrary finite wrapper syntax between graph
edges. The reference supplier is required only at the actual frontier. -/
theorem observe_from_references (h : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a)
    (refs : ∀ r, nextValue v = some r → ObservedTyped graph xi (.ref r) (xi r)) :
    ObservedTyped graph xi v a := by
  cases h with
  | ref r => exact refs r rfl
  | recvar e => exact Empty.elim e
  | var h => cases h
  | unit => exact .unit
  | bool => exact .bool
  | int => exact .int
  | floatBits => exact .floatBits
  | string => exact .string
  | bytes => exact .bytes
  | path => exact .path
  | char => exact .char
  | delay h => exact .delay h
  | inLeft h => exact .inLeft h
  | inRight h => exact .inRight h
  | both h k => exact .both (observe_from_references h refs) (observe_from_references k refs)
  | top h => exact .top (observe_from_references h refs)
  | view h => exact .view (observe_from_references h refs)
  | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue h k
  | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation h k
  | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (observe_from_references h refs) i o

/-- Actual reference lookup plus the accepted guard derive finite observation;
no canonical-value or typing oracle for projected terminal units is used. -/
theorem typed_observation (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (h : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a) : ObservedTyped graph xi v a := by
  have aux : ∀ n (v : Value R Empty) a,
      ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v a →
      (∀ r, nextValue v = some r → guard.rank r < n) → ObservedTyped graph xi v a := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro v a hv hb
        apply observe_from_references hv
        intro r hr
        exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ (hb r hr))
    | succ n ih =>
        intro v a hv hb
        apply observe_from_references hv
        intro r hr
        apply ObservedTyped.ref r
        apply ih (graph r) (xi r) (hg r)
        intro s hs
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
          (guard.decrease r s ((projection_edge graph r s).mpr hs))
          (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (hb r hr))
  exact aux guard.ceiling v a h (fun r _ => guard.bound r)

/-- Raw finite reference/view lookup. `here` retains the actual value, and
suppliers below determine its required introduction shape. No typing premise
occurs in this relation. Wrapper entry is not erased by this lookup. -/
inductive Head (graph : Graph R) : Value R Empty → Value R Empty → Prop where
  | here (v) : Head graph v v
  | ref : Head graph (graph r) w → Head graph (.ref r) w
  | view : Head graph v w → Head graph (.view v occurrence) w

theorem thunk_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .thunk a) :
    ∃ body, Head graph v (.delay body) ∧ CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext body a := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨body, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨body, .ref hh, ht⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨body, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨body, .view hh, ht⟩
  | delay h =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, h⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem thunk_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.thunk a)) :
    ∃ body, Head graph v (.delay body) ∧ CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext body a :=
  thunk_observation_of_eq h rfl

inductive CallableTerminal (xi : R → Ty) : Value R Empty → Ty → Ty → Prop where
  | lambdaValue : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext a) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      CallableTerminal xi (.lambda .value receipt a b r body consumer) a r
  | lambdaComputation : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext (.thunk a)) body b →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext consumer b r →
      CallableTerminal xi (.lambda .computation receipt a b r body consumer) a r
  | wrap : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext f (.callable a b) →
      AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext input c a → AdapterTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext output b d →
      CallableTerminal xi (.wrap f input output) c d

theorem callable_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .callable a b) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v w ∧ CallableTerminal xi w a b := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .ref hh, ht⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .view hh, ht⟩
  | lambdaValue h k =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, .lambdaValue h k⟩
  | lambdaComputation h k =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, .lambdaComputation h k⟩
  | wrap h i o ih =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, .wrap h.typed i o⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem callable_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.callable a b)) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v w ∧ CallableTerminal xi w a b :=
  callable_observation_of_eq h rfl

theorem union_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .union a b) :
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inLeft w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a) ∨
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inRight w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b) := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      rcases ih ht with ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ | ⟨w, hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨w, .ref hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨w, .ref hh, ht⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      rcases ih ht with ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ | ⟨w, hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inl ⟨w, .view hh, ht⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨w, .view hh, ht⟩
  | inLeft h =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact .inl ⟨_, .here _, h⟩
  | inRight h =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact .inr ⟨_, .here _, h⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem union_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.union a b)) :
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inLeft w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a) ∨
    (∃ w, Head graph v (.inRight w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b) :=
  union_observation_of_eq h rfl

theorem intersection_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .intersection a b) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v (.both w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a ∧
      ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ha, hb⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .ref hh, ha, hb⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ha, hb⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, .view hh, ha, hb⟩
  | both h k ih ik =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, .here _, h.typed, k.typed⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem intersection_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v (.intersection a b)) :
    ∃ w, Head graph v (.both w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a ∧
      ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w b :=
  intersection_observation_of_eq h rfl

theorem top_observation_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t) (ht : t = .top) :
    ∃ w a, Head graph v (.top w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, a, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, a, .ref hh, ht⟩
  | view h ih =>
      intro ht
      obtain ⟨w, a, hh, ht⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨w, a, .view hh, ht⟩
  | top h ih =>
      intro ht
      cases ht
      exact ⟨_, _, .here _, h.typed⟩
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem top_observation (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v .top) :
    ∃ w a, Head graph v (.top w) ∧ ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext w a :=
  top_observation_of_eq h rfl

theorem ObservedTyped.bottom_empty_of_eq (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v t)
    (ht : t = .bottom) : False := by
  revert ht
  induction h with
  | ref r h ih => intro ht; exact ih ht
  | view h ih => intro ht; exact ih ht
  | unit => intro ht; cases ht
  | bool => intro ht; cases ht
  | int => intro ht; cases ht
  | floatBits => intro ht; cases ht
  | string => intro ht; cases ht
  | bytes => intro ht; cases ht
  | path => intro ht; cases ht
  | char => intro ht; cases ht
  | delay h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inLeft h => intro ht; cases ht
  | inRight h => intro ht; cases ht
  | both h k ih ik => intro ht; cases ht
  | top h ih => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaValue h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | lambdaComputation h k => intro ht; cases ht
  | wrap h i o ih => intro ht; cases ht

theorem ObservedTyped.bottom_empty (h : ObservedTyped graph xi v .bottom) : False :=
  h.bottom_empty_of_eq rfl

theorem bottom_empty (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph))
    (h : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext v .bottom) : False :=
  (typed_observation hg guard h).bottom_empty



/-- Source application evaluates the callee first. The argument is shifted out
of the fresh callee binder before being delayed. -/
def sourceApply (callee argument : Comp R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  .bind callee (.dynamicCall (.var 0) (.delay (renameComp Nat.succ argument)))

theorem sourceApply_typed (hf : CompTyped xi emptyTy env callee (.callable a b))
    (ha : CompTyped xi emptyTy env argument a) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (sourceApply callee argument) b :=
  .bind hf (.dynamicCall (.var rfl) (.delay (renameComp_typed ha (fun _ _ h => h))))

/-- Projection used only for a typed computation construction. Full adapters
remain in the plans below; this is not operational metadata erasure. -/
def adapterBody : Adapter R Empty → Comp R Empty
  | .mk _ _ body _ _ => body

theorem adapterBody_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env adapter a b) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env a) (adapterBody adapter) b := by
  cases h with
  | mk h => exact h

def applyAdapter (adapter : Adapter R Empty) (v : Value R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  substComp (single v) (adapterBody adapter)

theorem applyAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env adapter a b)
    (hv : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env v a) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (applyAdapter adapter v) b :=
  substitute_top (adapterBody_typed h) hv

def consumeResult (body : Comp R Empty) (consumer : Adapter R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  .bind body (adapterBody consumer)

theorem consumeResult_typed (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy env body b)
    (hc : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env consumer b r) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (consumeResult body consumer) r :=
  .bind hb (adapterBody_typed hc)

/-- Value R Empty entry forces the carrier, then binds its value into the body. -/
def valueEntry (body : Comp R Empty) (carrier : Value R Empty) : Comp R Empty := .bind (.force carrier) body

theorem valueEntry_typed (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env a) body b)
    (hc : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (valueEntry body carrier) b :=
  .bind (.force hc) hb

/-- Computation entry substitutes the carrier itself; no force is inserted. -/
def computationEntry (body : Comp R Empty) (carrier : Value R Empty) : Comp R Empty := substComp (single carrier) body

theorem computationEntry_typed (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env (.thunk a)) body b)
    (hc : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) : CompTyped xi emptyTy env (computationEntry body carrier) b :=
  substitute_top hb hc

structure LambdaEntryPlan (R : Type) where
  mode : Original.Mode
  receipt : ReceiptTemplate
  argument : Ty
  bodyResult : Ty
  result : Ty
  body : Comp R Empty
  consumer : Adapter R Empty
  carrier : Value R Empty

def LambdaEntryPlan.computation (p : LambdaEntryPlan R) : Comp R Empty :=
  consumeResult
    (match p.mode with
    | .value => valueEntry p.body p.carrier
    | .computation => computationEntry p.body p.carrier)
    p.consumer

theorem lambda_value_plan_typed (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
    (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env a) body b) (hc : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env consumer b r)
    (ha : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (LambdaEntryPlan.computation
      ⟨.value, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩) r :=
  consumeResult_typed (valueEntry_typed hb ha) hc

theorem lambda_computation_plan_typed (receipt : ReceiptTemplate)
    (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env (.thunk a)) body b) (hc : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env consumer b r)
    (ha : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk a)) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (LambdaEntryPlan.computation
      ⟨.computation, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩) r :=
  consumeResult_typed (computationEntry_typed hb ha) hc

/-- Input adaptation runs inside the delayed carrier. The output adapter runs
on the inner call's returned value. Entire adapter metadata is retained. -/
structure WrapEntryPlan (R : Type) where
  inner : Value R Empty
  input : Adapter R Empty
  output : Adapter R Empty
  carrier : Value R Empty

def WrapEntryPlan.computation (p : WrapEntryPlan R) : Comp R Empty :=
  consumeResult
    (.dynamicCall p.inner (.delay (.bind (.force p.carrier) (adapterBody p.input))))
    p.output

theorem wrap_plan_typed (hf : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env inner (.callable a b))
    (hi : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env input c a) (ho : AdapterTyped xi emptyTy env output b d)
    (hc : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env carrier (.thunk c)) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩) d :=
  consumeResult_typed
    (.dynamicCall hf (.delay (.bind (.force hc) (adapterBody_typed hi)))) ho

def Handler.input : Handler R Empty → Ty
  | .mk _ a _ _ _ => a

def Handler.values : Handler R Empty → ValueArms R Empty
  | .mk _ _ _ vs _ => vs

def Handler.operations : Handler R Empty → OperationArms R Empty
  | .mk _ _ _ _ os => os

theorem handler_input (hh : HandlerTyped xi emptyTy env h a b) : h.input = a := by
  cases hh
  rfl

theorem handler_values (hh : HandlerTyped xi emptyTy env h a b) : ValueArmsTyped xi emptyTy env h.values a b := by
  cases hh with
  | mk hv _ => exact hv

theorem handler_operations (hh : HandlerTyped xi emptyTy env h a b) : OperationArmsTyped xi emptyTy env h.operations a b := by
  cases hh with
  | mk _ ho => exact ho

/-- A concrete callable encoding of K. Its actual response binder is the
lambda parameter, and its result adapter is the identity computation. -/
def continuationValue (q a : Ty) (k : Comp R Empty) : Value R Empty :=
  .lambda .value ⟨[], []⟩ q a a k (.mk a a (.ret (.var 0)) [] [])

theorem continuationValue_typed (hk : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env q) k a) :
    ValueTyped xi emptyTy env (continuationValue q a k) (.callable q a) :=
  .lambdaValue hk (.mk (.ret (.var rfl)))

def pairSubstitution (payload continuation : Value R Empty) : Nat → Value R Empty
  | 0 => payload
  | 1 => continuation
  | n+2 => .var n

theorem substitute_pair
    (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend (extend env kty) pty) body b)
    (hp : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env p pty) (hk : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env k kty) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (substComp (pairSubstitution p k) body) b := by
  apply substComp_typed hb
  intro i t hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst t
      exact hp
  | succ i =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
          subst t
          exact hk
      | succ i => exact .var hi

def attemptOperation (h : Handler R Empty) (op : OperationInstance) (p : Value R Empty) (k body : Comp R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  substComp (pairSubstitution p (continuationValue op.responseType h.input k)) body

theorem attemptOperation_typed (hh : HandlerTyped xi emptyTy env h a b)
    (hp : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env p op.payloadType) (hk : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env op.responseType) k a)
    (hb : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend (extend env (.callable op.responseType a)) op.payloadType)
      body (.union (.base .unit) b)) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy env (attemptOperation h op p k body) (.union (.base .unit) b) := by
  unfold attemptOperation
  rw [handler_input hh]
  exact substitute_pair hb hp (continuationValue_typed hk)

/-- H K is separately constructed by reinstating the shifted handler under
K's response binder. It is never passed to a selected operation arm. -/
def forwardedContinuation (h : Handler R Empty) (k : Comp R Empty) : Comp R Empty :=
  .handle (renameHandler Nat.succ h) k

theorem forwardedContinuation_typed (hh : HandlerTyped xi emptyTy env h a b)
    (hk : CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env q) k a) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend env q) (forwardedContinuation h k) b :=
  .handle (renameHandler_typed hh (fun _ _ h => h)) hk

inductive Event (R : Type) where
  | silent
  | lookup (reference : R)
  | observeView (occurrence : ViewOccurrence)
  | lambdaEntry (plan : LambdaEntryPlan R)
  | wrapEntry (plan : WrapEntryPlan R)
  | leaveScope (owner : Nat)
  | leaveExpose (effectView resultView : ViewOccurrence)

inductive Step (graph : Graph R) : Comp R Empty → Event R → Comp R Empty → Prop where
  | forceRef : Step graph (.force (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.force (graph r))
  | unionRef : Step graph (.unionCase (.ref r) l right) (.lookup r) (.unionCase (graph r) l right)
  | chooseLeftRef : Step graph (.chooseLeft (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.chooseLeft (graph r))
  | chooseRightRef : Step graph (.chooseRight (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.chooseRight (graph r))
  | absurdRef : Step graph (.absurd (.ref r)) (.lookup r) (.absurd (graph r))
  | callRef : Step graph (.dynamicCall (.ref r) arg) (.lookup r) (.dynamicCall (graph r) arg)
  | absurdView : Step graph (.absurd (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.absurd v)
  | valueRef : Step graph (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (.ref r))) (.lookup r)
      (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (graph r)))
  | operationRef : Step graph (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (.ref r))) (.lookup r)
      (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (graph r)))
  | force : Step graph (.force (.delay body)) .silent body
  | forceView : Step graph (.force (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.force v)
  | bindReturn : Step graph (.bind (.ret v) body) .silent (substComp (single v) body)
  | bind : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.bind m body) e (.bind n body)
  | unionLeft : Step graph (.unionCase (.inLeft v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) l)
  | unionRight : Step graph (.unionCase (.inRight v) l r) .silent (substComp (single v) r)
  | unionView : Step graph (.unionCase (.view v o) l r) (.observeView o) (.unionCase v l r)
  | chooseLeft : Step graph (.chooseLeft (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseRight : Step graph (.chooseRight (.both v)) .silent (.ret v)
  | chooseLeftView : Step graph (.chooseLeft (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseLeft v)
  | chooseRightView : Step graph (.chooseRight (.view v o)) (.observeView o) (.chooseRight v)
  | scope : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.scope owner m) e (.scope owner n)
  | scopeReturn : Step graph (.scope owner (.ret v)) (.leaveScope owner) (.ret v)
  | expose : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.expose ev rv m) e (.expose ev rv n)
  | exposeReturn : Step graph (.expose ev rv (.ret v)) (.leaveExpose ev rv) (.ret v)
  | callView : Step graph (.dynamicCall (.view f o) arg) (.observeView o) (.dynamicCall f arg)
  | callLambda :
      Step graph (.dynamicCall (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) carrier)
        (.lambdaEntry ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
        (LambdaEntryPlan.computation ⟨mode, receipt, a, b, r, body, consumer, carrier⟩)
  | callWrap :
      Step graph (.dynamicCall (.wrap inner input output) carrier)
        (.wrapEntry ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)
        (WrapEntryPlan.computation ⟨inner, input, output, carrier⟩)

  | bindRequest : Step graph (.bind (.request op p k) body) .silent
      (.request op p (.bind k (renameComp (Original.up Nat.succ) body)))
  | bindFail : Step graph (.bind (.fail reason) body) .silent (.fail reason)
  | scopeRequest : Step graph (.scope owner (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.request op p (.scope owner k))
  | scopeFail : Step graph (.scope owner (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | exposeRequest : Step graph (.expose ev rv (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.request op p (.expose ev rv k))
  | exposeFail : Step graph (.expose ev rv (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | handle : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.handle h m) e (.handle h n)
  | handleReturn : Step graph (.handle h (.ret v)) .silent (.tryValue h v h.values)
  | handleRequest : Step graph (.handle h (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.tryOperation h op p k h.operations)
  | handleFail : Step graph (.handle h (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | valueEmpty : Step graph (.tryValue h v .nil) .silent (.fail .matchFailure)
  | valueCons : Step graph (.tryValue h v (.cons body rest)) .silent
      (.waitValue h v rest (substComp (single v) body))
  | valueWait : Step graph m e n → Step graph (.waitValue h v rest m) e (.waitValue h v rest n)
  | valueYes : Step graph (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (.inRight result))) .silent (.ret result)
  | valueNo : Step graph (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (.inLeft unit))) .silent (.tryValue h v rest)
  | valueView : Step graph (.waitValue h v rest (.ret (.view result o))) (.observeView o)
      (.waitValue h v rest (.ret result))
  | valueFail : Step graph (.waitValue h v rest (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | valueRequest : Step graph (.waitValue h v rest (.request op p k)) .silent
      (.request op p (.waitValue (renameHandler Nat.succ h) (renameValue Nat.succ v)
        (renameValueArms Nat.succ rest) k))
  | operationEmpty : Step graph (.tryOperation h op p k .nil) .silent
      (.request op p (forwardedContinuation h k))
  | operationCons : Step graph (.tryOperation h op p k (.cons op true body rest)) .silent
      (.waitOperation h op p k rest (attemptOperation h op p k body))
  | operationSkip : (armOp ≠ op ∨ eligible = false) →
      Step graph (.tryOperation h op p k (.cons armOp eligible body rest)) .silent
        (.tryOperation h op p k rest)
  | operationWait : Step graph m e n →
      Step graph (.waitOperation h op p k rest m) e (.waitOperation h op p k rest n)
  | operationYes : Step graph (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (.inRight result))) .silent (.ret result)
  | operationNo : Step graph (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (.inLeft unit))) .silent
      (.tryOperation h op p k rest)
  | operationView : Step graph (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret (.view result o))) (.observeView o)
      (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.ret result))
  | operationFail : Step graph (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.fail reason)) .silent (.fail reason)
  | operationRequest : Step graph (.waitOperation h op p k rest (.request nextOp nextP nextK)) .silent
      (.request nextOp nextP (.waitOperation (renameHandler Nat.succ h) op
        (renameValue Nat.succ p) (renameComp (Original.up Nat.succ) k)
        (renameOperationArms Nat.succ rest) nextK))

theorem reference_type (h : ValueTyped xi emptyTy env (.ref r) a) : xi r = a := by
  cases h
  rfl

theorem preservation (hg : WellTyped graph xi) (step : Step graph m e n) (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext n a := by
  induction step generalizing a with
  | forceRef =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => exact .force ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | unionRef =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => exact .unionCase ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _) hl hr
  | chooseLeftRef =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => exact .chooseLeft ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | chooseRightRef =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => exact .chooseRight ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | absurdRef =>
      cases h with
      | absurd hv => exact .absurd ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _)
  | callRef =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hv ha => exact .dynamicCall ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _) ha
  | absurdView =>
      cases h with
      | absurd hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .absurd hv
  | valueRef =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv' => exact .waitValue hh hv hr (.ret ((reference_type hv') ▸ hg _))
  | operationRef =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => exact .waitOperation hh hp hk hr (.ret ((reference_type hv) ▸ hg _))
  | force =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | delay hb => exact hb
  | forceView =>
      cases h with
      | force hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .force hv
  | bindReturn =>
      cases h with
      | bind hv hb => cases hv with | ret hv => exact substitute_top hb hv
  | bind _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => exact .bind (ih hm) hb
  | unionLeft =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl _ => cases hv with | inLeft hv => exact substitute_top hl hv
  | unionRight =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv _ hr => cases hv with | inRight hv => exact substitute_top hr hv
  | unionView =>
      cases h with
      | unionCase hv hl hr => cases hv with | view hv => exact .unionCase hv hl hr
  | chooseLeft =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | both hl _ => exact .ret hl
  | chooseRight =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | both _ hr => exact .ret hr
  | chooseLeftView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseLeft hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseLeft hv
  | chooseRightView =>
      cases h with
      | chooseRight hv => cases hv with | view hv => exact .chooseRight hv
  | scope _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact .scope (ih hm)
  | scopeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => exact hm
  | expose _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact .expose (ih hm)
  | exposeReturn =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => exact hm
  | callView =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha => cases hf with | view hf => exact .dynamicCall hf ha
  | callLambda =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | lambdaValue hb hc => exact lambda_value_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
          | lambdaComputation hb hc => exact lambda_computation_plan_typed _ hb hc ha
  | callWrap =>
      cases h with
      | dynamicCall hf ha =>
          cases hf with
          | wrap hf hi ho => exact wrap_plan_typed hf hi ho ha

  | bindRequest =>
      cases h with
      | bind hm hb => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.bind hk (renameComp_typed hb (up_typed (env := emptyContext) (target := extend emptyContext _) (r := Nat.succ) (fun _ _ h => h) _)))
  | bindFail => exact .fail
  | scopeRequest =>
      cases h with
      | scope hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.scope hk)
  | scopeFail => exact .fail
  | exposeRequest =>
      cases h with
      | expose hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.expose hk)
  | exposeFail => exact .fail
  | handle _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | handle hh hm => exact .handle hh (ih hm)
  | handleReturn =>
      cases h with
      | handle hh hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => exact .tryValue hh hv (handler_values hh)
  | handleRequest =>
      cases h with
      | handle hh hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .tryOperation hh hp hk (handler_operations hh)
  | handleFail => exact .fail
  | valueEmpty => exact .fail
  | valueCons =>
      cases h with
      | tryValue hh hv hs => cases hs with
        | cons hb hr => exact .waitValue hh hv hr (substitute_top hb hv)
  | valueWait _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr hm => exact .waitValue hh hv hr (ih hm)
  | valueYes =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue _ _ _ hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => cases hv with
          | inRight hv => exact .ret hv
  | valueNo =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr _ => exact .tryValue hh hv hr
  | valueView =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv' => cases hv' with
          | view hv' => exact .waitValue hh hv hr (.ret hv')
  | valueFail => exact .fail
  | valueRequest =>
      cases h with
      | waitValue hh hv hr hm => cases hm with
        | request hp hk => exact .request hp (.waitValue
            (renameHandler_typed hh (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameValue_typed hv (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameValueArms_typed hr (fun _ _ h => h)) hk)
  | operationEmpty =>
      cases h with
      | tryOperation hh hp hk _ => exact .request hp (forwardedContinuation_typed hh hk)
  | operationCons =>
      cases h with
      | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => cases hs with
        | cons hb hr => exact .waitOperation hh hp hk hr (attemptOperation_typed hh hp hk hb)
  | operationSkip _ =>
      cases h with
      | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => cases hs with
        | cons _ hr => exact .tryOperation hh hp hk hr
  | operationWait _ ih =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr hm => exact .waitOperation hh hp hk hr (ih hm)
  | operationYes =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation _ _ _ _ hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => cases hv with
          | inRight hv => exact .ret hv
  | operationNo =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr _ => exact .tryOperation hh hp hk hr
  | operationView =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr hm => cases hm with
        | ret hv => cases hv with
          | view hv => exact .waitOperation hh hp hk hr (.ret hv)
  | operationFail => exact .fail
  | operationRequest =>
      cases h with
      | waitOperation hh hp hk hr hm => cases hm with
        | request hp' hk' => exact .request hp' (.waitOperation
            (renameHandler_typed hh (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameValue_typed hp (fun _ _ h => h))
            (renameComp_typed hk (up_typed (env := emptyContext) (target := extend emptyContext _) (r := Nat.succ) (fun _ _ h => h) _))
            (renameOperationArms_typed hr (fun _ _ h => h)) hk')

/-- The terminal alternatives are only the three concrete outer constructors;
requests and failures underneath a frame must take their propagation step. -/
inductive Terminal : Comp R Empty → Prop where
  | returned (v : Value R Empty) : Terminal (.ret v)
  | requested (op p k) : Terminal (.request op p k)
  | failed (reason) : Terminal (.fail reason)

def CanProgress (graph : Graph R) (m : Comp R Empty) : Prop := Terminal m ∨ ∃ e n, Step graph m e n

theorem operation_trials_progress (h : Handler R Empty) (op : OperationInstance)
    (p : Value R Empty) (k : Comp R Empty) (arms : OperationArms R Empty) : CanProgress graph (.tryOperation h op p k arms) := by
  cases arms with
  | nil => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationEmpty⟩
  | cons armOp eligible body rest =>
      cases eligible with
      | false => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationSkip (.inr rfl)⟩
      | true =>
          by_cases equal : armOp = op
          · subst armOp
            exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationCons⟩
          · exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationSkip (.inl equal)⟩

theorem closed_progress (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph)) (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) : CanProgress graph m := by
  cases h with
  | ret _ => exact .inl (.returned _)
  | request _ _ => exact .inl (.requested _ _ _)
  | fail => exact .inl (.failed _)
  | force hv =>
      obtain ⟨body, hh, _⟩ := thunk_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv)
      cases hh with
      | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .force⟩
      | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .forceRef⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .forceView⟩
  | bind hm hb =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .bindReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .bindRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .bindFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .bind step⟩
  | unionCase hv hl hr =>
      rcases union_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv) with ⟨w, hh, _⟩ | ⟨w, hh, _⟩
      · cases hh with
        | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionLeft⟩
        | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionRef⟩
        | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩
      · cases hh with
        | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionRight⟩
        | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionRef⟩
        | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .unionView⟩
  | chooseLeft hv =>
      obtain ⟨w, hh, _, _⟩ := intersection_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv)
      cases hh with
      | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeft⟩
      | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftRef⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseLeftView⟩
  | chooseRight hv =>
      obtain ⟨w, hh, _, _⟩ := intersection_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv)
      cases hh with
      | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRight⟩
      | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightRef⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .chooseRightView⟩
  | absurd hv => exact False.elim (bottom_empty hg guard hv)
  | scope hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .scopeReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .scopeRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .scopeFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .scope step⟩
  | expose hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .exposeReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .exposeRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .exposeFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .expose step⟩
  | dynamicCall hf ha =>
      obtain ⟨w, hh, ht⟩ := callable_observation (typed_observation hg guard hf)
      cases hh with
      | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callRef⟩
      | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callView⟩
      | here =>
          cases ht with
          | lambdaValue _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩
          | lambdaComputation _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callLambda⟩
          | wrap _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .callWrap⟩

  | handle hh hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .handleReturn⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .handleRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .handleFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .handle step⟩
  | tryValue hh hv hs =>
      cases hs with
      | nil => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueEmpty⟩
      | cons _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueCons⟩
  | waitValue hh hv hs hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned v =>
            cases hm with
            | ret hv =>
                rcases union_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv) with ⟨w, hh, _⟩ | ⟨w, hh, _⟩
                · cases hh with
                  | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueNo⟩
                  | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueRef⟩
                  | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueView⟩
                · cases hh with
                  | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueYes⟩
                  | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueRef⟩
                  | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueView⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .valueFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .valueWait step⟩
  | tryOperation hh hp hk hs => exact operation_trials_progress _ _ _ _ _
  | waitOperation hh hp hk hs hm =>
      rcases closed_progress hg guard hm with terminal | ⟨e, n, step⟩
      · cases terminal with
        | returned v =>
            cases hm with
            | ret hv =>
                rcases union_observation (typed_observation hg guard hv) with ⟨w, hh, _⟩ | ⟨w, hh, _⟩
                · cases hh with
                  | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationNo⟩
                  | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationRef⟩
                  | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationView⟩
                · cases hh with
                  | here => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationYes⟩
                  | ref _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationRef⟩
                  | view _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationView⟩
        | requested _ _ _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationRequest⟩
        | failed _ => exact .inr ⟨_, _, .operationFail⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨e, _, .operationWait step⟩

inductive Prefix (graph : Graph R) : Comp R Empty → List (Event R) → Comp R Empty → Prop where
  | refl (m : Comp R Empty) : Prefix graph m [] m
  | cons : Step graph m e n → Prefix graph n events last → Prefix graph m (e :: events) last

theorem prefix_preservation (hg : WellTyped graph xi) (trace : Prefix graph m events n) (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext n a := by
  induction trace generalizing a with
  | refl => exact h
  | cons step _ ih => exact ih (preservation hg step h)

/-- All raw finite internal prefixes, including arbitrary actual attempt code. -/
theorem finite_prefix_safety (hg : WellTyped graph xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph)) (h : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext m a) (trace : Prefix graph m events n) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext n a ∧ CanProgress graph n := by
  have hn := prefix_preservation hg trace h
  exact ⟨hn, closed_progress hg guard hn⟩


end YulangClosure.HandlerGraph

# Combined higher-order handlers and guarded value graphs

Status: candidate research construction, pending primary elaboration and fresh
independent review. Production authority: none. Parent:
`HO-HANDLER-GRAPH-COMPOSITION-1`, paper guarded values 180–196, recursive
allocation 980–993, shallow handlers 399–456, local preservation 1069–1088,

## Original claim and candidate application

The parent needs one actual syntax and execution relation supporting both
accepted languages simultaneously. Separate safety theorems were insufficient:
the old graph machine suspends requests/failures inside finite evaluation
contexts, while the old handler machine propagates them to the root. The new
candidate constructs the shared grammar, derives finite observations from the
actual graph typing and guard, and proves preservation and root-only progress
for every finite raw internal prefix. It then connects both old machines and
consumes the actual old recursive allocation supplier under an independently
typed combined handler.

`HandlerGraphSyntax` has six mutually recursive sorts: Value, Comp, Adapter,
Handler, ValueArms and OperationArms. Every accepted Graph and Handler
constructor is represented structurally. References, recursive names and local
indices remain distinct. Lambda bodies, outer result consumers, adapter input
bodies, request response binders, value-arm binders and both operation-arm
binders contain the full combined language. The existing Ty, modes, operation
instances, literal payloads and all metadata fields are reused unchanged.
Extrinsic typing and structural renaming/substitution cover every constructor.
The six cancellation lemmas justify substitution after binder insertion; they
are applied to the actual context resumption equation.

`HandlerGraphEmbedding` recursively embeds both old languages in arbitrary
typing contexts. Its renaming/substitution commutation lemmas are consumed by
actual old-step simulation. `liftGraph_typed` derives new node typing from old
node derivations. `liftGraph_projection` proves exact equality of the guard
projections, so `liftGraph_guard` transports the existing guard. Projected unit
is only a stopping token; it supplies neither typing nor a canonical value.

`HandlerGraphSafety` derives `ObservedTyped` from actual node typing and the
transparent successor rank. Intersection has two separate premises, top retains
its underlying type witness, and wrap retains different inner and outer callable
types and both adapters. No typing premise occurs in `Step`. Lookup is explicit
for force, union/intersection elimination, absurd and dynamic call, and also for
references returned as No/Yes carriers inside both kinds of wait. The machine
retains all shallow-handler trial, ordering, skipping, nesting, propagation and
restoration rules. The selected arm receives the original K:Q→A; only exhaustion
constructs the shifted handler around K, yielding H K:Q→B. Eligibility remains
raw Bool data, with no native permission adequacy claim. `preservation` assumes
actual closed graph typing; `closed_progress` additionally consumes the guard.
`finite_prefix_safety` quantifies over every raw finite internal trace.

`HandlerGraphCorrespondence.graph_step` and `handler_step` map every old raw
step, actual event and complete lambda/wrap entry plan. Their finite trace
versions preserve event order. `propagate_graph_request` and
`propagate_graph_failure` construct finite sequences through every old context;
`graph_suspended_root` consumes the old full suspension decomposition.
`graph_request_correspondence` retains the identical full operation instance and
payload and derives the resulting continuation typing from the old contextual
computation typing plus actual propagation. `graph_resume_equation` states that
substituting any combined response into the propagated continuation equals the
same outer context around the original response-substituted K.
`old_graph_resume_equation` further identifies this with the embedding of the
old resumed contextual computation. `graph_resumption_safety` applies the
supplier to arbitrary independently typed responses and every subsequent
internal prefix, without consuming the saved code or imposing linear use.

`source_rec_under_handler` calls the exact accepted `source_rec_allocation`,
lifts its actual allocated graph and closed body, derives combined typing and
guard, and establishes every finite prefix under an independently typed combined
handler. Its only fresh guard premise is the old actual `FreshNoCycle`; no new
fresh-node typing or rank supplier is introduced. `SourceExample` starts with
an empty old graph, closes a genuinely recursive source lambda with a request
and self-call in the response continuation, gives the exact allocated-node
equation, and executes its request through handler selection. `Examples` also
executes a recursive graph lambda through a graph-backed attempt/wait result,
and a nested request followed by restoration, reference lookup and Yes return.
The examples supplement the quantified statements.

syntax/allocation/observation construction are reused within their actual finite

compose. The previous contextual graph terminal convention is not reused as

The original paper remains OPEN for omitted μ/type-changing roll,

# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain
machine.rs `Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`,
`Machine::extend`, closure/Callee branches and receiving.rs lambda schema
construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

## Intake and checks

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`
invocation failed because the executable was absent; the generation was then
performed with python3. This was a file-writing failure before any write, not a
failed proof check. Primary owns bounded elaboration, public signature/axiom
inspection, distinguishing examples, repairs after author STOP and fresh
independent review. Author/coauthor cannot independently certify this candidate.
Only the four exact leased files were created; there are no scratch paths,
background processes, descendants, compiler changes or Git operations.

import YulangClosure.HandlerGraphSafety

namespace YulangClosure.HandlerGraph
open HigherOrder (Ty Context emptyContext extend OperationInstance ViewOccurrence ReceiptTemplate PathCorrespondence)
variable {R : Type} {xi : R → Ty} {graph : Graph R}

def graphLambdaPlan (p : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.LambdaEntryPlan R) : LambdaEntryPlan R :=
  ⟨p.mode, p.receipt, p.argument, p.bodyResult, p.result,
    graphComp p.body, graphAdapter p.consumer, graphValue p.carrier⟩

def graphWrapPlan (p : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.WrapEntryPlan R) : WrapEntryPlan R :=
  ⟨graphValue p.inner, graphAdapter p.input, graphAdapter p.output, graphValue p.carrier⟩

def graphEvent : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.Event R → Event R
  | .silent => .silent
  | .lookup r => .lookup r
  | .observeView o => .observeView o
  | .lambdaEntry p => .lambdaEntry (graphLambdaPlan p)
  | .wrapEntry p => .wrapEntry (graphWrapPlan p)
  | .leaveScope o => .leaveScope o
  | .leaveExpose e r => .leaveExpose e r

theorem graph_single (v : HigherOrderGraph.Value R Empty) (i : Nat) :
    graphValue (HigherOrderGraph.Safety.single v i) = single (graphValue (R := R) (S := Empty) v) i := by
  cases i <;> rfl

theorem graph_substitute_top (v : HigherOrderGraph.Value R Empty) (m : HigherOrderGraph.Comp R Empty) :
    graphComp (HigherOrderGraph.substComp (HigherOrderGraph.Safety.single v) m) =
      substComp (single (graphValue (R := R) (S := Empty) v)) (graphComp m) :=
  graphComp_subst m _ _ (graph_single v)

theorem graph_adapterBody (c : HigherOrderGraph.Adapter R Empty) :
    graphComp (HigherOrderGraph.Safety.adapterBody c) = adapterBody (graphAdapter c) := by
  cases c <;> rfl

theorem graph_lambda_computation (p : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.LambdaEntryPlan R) :
    graphComp p.computation = (graphLambdaPlan p).computation := by
  cases p with
  | mk mode receipt a b r body consumer carrier =>
      cases mode <;>
        simp only [HigherOrderGraph.Safety.LambdaEntryPlan.computation, HigherOrderGraph.Safety.consumeResult,
          HigherOrderGraph.Safety.valueEntry, HigherOrderGraph.Safety.computationEntry, graphComp,
          graph_substitute_top, graph_adapterBody, graphLambdaPlan,
          LambdaEntryPlan.computation, consumeResult, valueEntry, computationEntry]

theorem graph_wrap_computation (p : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.WrapEntryPlan R) :
    graphComp p.computation = (graphWrapPlan p).computation := by
  cases p with
  | mk inner input output carrier =>
      simp only [HigherOrderGraph.Safety.WrapEntryPlan.computation, HigherOrderGraph.Safety.consumeResult,
        graphComp, graphValue, graph_adapterBody, graphWrapPlan,
        WrapEntryPlan.computation, consumeResult]

def handlerLambdaPlan (p : HigherOrder.Handler.LambdaEntryPlan) : LambdaEntryPlan R :=
  ⟨p.mode, p.receipt, p.argument, p.bodyResult, p.result,
    handlerComp p.body, handlerAdapter p.consumer, handlerValue p.carrier⟩

def handlerWrapPlan (p : HigherOrder.Handler.WrapEntryPlan) : WrapEntryPlan R :=
  ⟨handlerValue p.inner, handlerAdapter p.input, handlerAdapter p.output, handlerValue p.carrier⟩

def handlerEvent : HigherOrder.Handler.Event → Event R
  | .silent => .silent
  | .observeView o => .observeView o
  | .lambdaEntry p => .lambdaEntry (handlerLambdaPlan p)
  | .wrapEntry p => .wrapEntry (handlerWrapPlan p)
  | .leaveScope o => .leaveScope o
  | .leaveExpose e r => .leaveExpose e r

theorem handler_single (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (i : Nat) :
    handlerValue (HigherOrder.Handler.single v i) = single (handlerValue (R := R) (S := Empty) v) i := by
  cases i <;> rfl

theorem handler_substitute_top (v : HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (m : HigherOrder.Handler.Comp) :
    handlerComp (HigherOrder.Handler.substComp (HigherOrder.Handler.single v) m) =
      substComp (single (handlerValue (R := R) (S := Empty) v)) (handlerComp m) :=
  handlerComp_subst m _ _ (handler_single v)

theorem handler_adapterBody (c : HigherOrder.Handler.Adapter) :
    handlerComp (R := R) (S := Empty) (HigherOrder.Handler.adapterBody c) = adapterBody (handlerAdapter c) := by
  cases c <;> rfl

theorem handler_lambda_computation (p : HigherOrder.Handler.LambdaEntryPlan) :
    handlerComp p.computation = (handlerLambdaPlan (R := R) p).computation := by
  cases p with
  | mk mode receipt a b r body consumer carrier =>
      cases mode <;>
        simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.LambdaEntryPlan.computation, HigherOrder.Handler.consumeResult,
          HigherOrder.Handler.valueEntry, HigherOrder.Handler.computationEntry, handlerComp,
          handler_substitute_top, handler_adapterBody, handlerLambdaPlan,
          LambdaEntryPlan.computation, consumeResult, valueEntry, computationEntry]

theorem handler_wrap_computation (p : HigherOrder.Handler.WrapEntryPlan) :
    handlerComp p.computation = (handlerWrapPlan (R := R) p).computation := by
  cases p with
  | mk inner input output carrier =>
      simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.WrapEntryPlan.computation, HigherOrder.Handler.consumeResult,
        handlerComp, handlerValue, handler_adapterBody, handlerWrapPlan,
        WrapEntryPlan.computation, consumeResult]

theorem handler_input_eq (h : HigherOrder.Handler.Handler) :
    (handlerHandler (R := R) (S := Empty) h).input = h.input := by cases h <;> rfl

theorem handler_values_eq (h : HigherOrder.Handler.Handler) :
    handlerValueArms h.values = (handlerHandler (R := R) (S := Empty) h).values := by cases h <;> rfl

theorem handler_operations_eq (h : HigherOrder.Handler.Handler) :
    handlerOperationArms h.operations = (handlerHandler (R := R) (S := Empty) h).operations := by cases h <;> rfl

theorem handler_continuation (q a : Ty) (k : HigherOrder.Handler.Comp) :
    handlerValue (HigherOrder.Handler.continuationValue q a k) =
      continuationValue (R := R) q a (handlerComp k) := rfl

theorem handler_attempt (h : HigherOrder.Handler.Handler) (op : OperationInstance)
    (p : HigherOrder.Handler.Value) (k body : HigherOrder.Handler.Comp) :
    handlerComp (HigherOrder.Handler.attemptOperation h op p k body) =
      attemptOperation (R := R) (handlerHandler h) op (handlerValue p) (handlerComp k) (handlerComp body) := by
  unfold HigherOrder.Handler.attemptOperation attemptOperation
  rw [handler_input_eq]
  apply handlerComp_subst
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i => cases i <;> rfl

theorem handler_forwarded (h : HigherOrder.Handler.Handler) (k : HigherOrder.Handler.Comp) :
    handlerComp (HigherOrder.Handler.forwardedContinuation h k) =
      forwardedContinuation (R := R) (handlerHandler h) (handlerComp k) := by
  simp only [HigherOrder.Handler.forwardedContinuation, handlerComp,
    handlerHandler_rename, forwardedContinuation]

    Step (liftGraph g) (graphComp m) (graphEvent e) (graphComp n) := by

  | forceRef =>
      simp only [graphComp, graphValue, graphEvent, graph_substitute_top, graph_lambda_computation, graph_wrap_computation, liftGraph, graphLambdaPlan, graphWrapPlan]
      exact .forceRef
  | unionRef =>
      simp only [graphComp, graphValue, graphEvent, graph_substitute_top, graph_lambda_computation, graph_wrap_computation, liftGraph, graphLambdaPlan, graphWrapPlan]
      exact .unionRef

      simp only [graphComp, graphValue, graphEvent, graph_substitute_top, graph_lambda_computation, graph_wrap_computation, liftGraph, graphLambdaPlan, graphWrapPlan]
      exact .chooseLeftRef

      exact .chooseRightRef

      exact .absurdRef
  | callRef =>
      simp only [graphComp, graphValue, graphEvent, graph_substitute_top, graph_lambda_computation, graph_wrap_computation, liftGraph, graphLambdaPlan, graphWrapPlan]

  | absurdView =>

      exact .absurdView
  | force =>

      exact .chooseLeftView
  | chooseRightView =>
      simp only [graphComp, graphValue, graphEvent, graph_substitute_top, graph_lambda_computation, graph_wrap_computation, liftGraph, graphLambdaPlan, graphWrapPlan]

  | scope _ ih =>

theorem Prefix.append (h : Prefix graph m es n) (k : Prefix graph n fs last) :
    Prefix graph m (es ++ fs) last := by
  revert k
  induction h with
  | refl => intro k; exact k
  | cons step _ ih => intro k; exact .cons step (ih k)

theorem Prefix.bind (h : Prefix graph m es n) (body : Comp R Empty) :
    Prefix graph (.bind m body) es (.bind n body) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | cons step _ ih => exact .cons (.bind step) ih

theorem Prefix.scope (h : Prefix graph m es n) (owner : Nat) :
    Prefix graph (.scope owner m) es (.scope owner n) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | cons step _ ih => exact .cons (.scope step) ih

theorem Prefix.expose (h : Prefix graph m es n) (ev rv : ViewOccurrence) :
    Prefix graph (.expose ev rv m) es (.expose ev rv n) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | cons step _ ih => exact .cons (.expose step) ih

/-- The old context is traversed structurally, retaining every actual body. -/
def graphContextPlug : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R → Comp R Empty → Comp R Empty
  | .hole, m => m
  | .bind k body, m => .bind (graphContextPlug k m) (graphComp body)
  | .scope owner k, m => .scope owner (graphContextPlug k m)
  | .expose ev rv k, m => .expose ev rv (graphContextPlug k m)

theorem graph_plug (k : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R) (m : HigherOrderGraph.Comp R Empty) :
    graphComp (k.plug m) = graphContextPlug k (graphComp m) := by
  induction k with
  | hole => rfl
  | bind k body ih => exact congrArg (fun m => Comp.bind m (graphComp body)) ih
  | scope owner k ih => exact congrArg (Comp.scope owner) ih
  | expose ev rv k ih => exact congrArg (Comp.expose ev rv) ih

/-- Each outer bind moves under the response binder. Its own result binder
remains zero, so the inserted response slot is skipped with `up succ`. -/
def graphContinuation : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R → Comp R Empty → Comp R Empty
  | .hole, k => k
  | .bind c body, k => .bind (graphContinuation c k) (renameComp (Original.up Nat.succ) (graphComp body))
  | .scope owner c, k => .scope owner (graphContinuation c k)
  | .expose ev rv c, k => .expose ev rv (graphContinuation c k)

theorem propagate_graph_request (c : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R)
    (op : OperationInstance) (p : Value R Empty) (k : Comp R Empty) :
    ∃ events, Prefix graph (graphContextPlug c (.request op p k)) events
      (.request op p (graphContinuation c k)) := by
  induction c with
  | hole => exact ⟨[], .refl _⟩
  | bind c body ih =>
      obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨events ++ [.silent], (trace.bind _).append (.cons .bindRequest (.refl _))⟩
  | scope owner c ih =>
      obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨events ++ [.silent], (trace.scope owner).append (.cons .scopeRequest (.refl _))⟩
  | expose ev rv c ih =>
      obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨events ++ [.silent], (trace.expose ev rv).append (.cons .exposeRequest (.refl _))⟩

theorem propagate_graph_failure (c : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R)
    (reason : Original.Failure) :
    ∃ events, Prefix graph (graphContextPlug c (.fail reason)) events (.fail reason) := by
  induction c with
  | hole => exact ⟨[], .refl _⟩
  | bind c body ih =>
      obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨events ++ [.silent], (trace.bind _).append (.cons .bindFail (.refl _))⟩
  | scope owner c ih =>
      obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨events ++ [.silent], (trace.scope owner).append (.cons .scopeFail (.refl _))⟩
  | expose ev rv c ih =>
      obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨events ++ [.silent], (trace.expose ev rv).append (.cons .exposeFail (.refl _))⟩

/-- Actual response equation, for arbitrary combined response values (including
references and code with handlers), arbitrary old contexts and original K. -/
theorem graph_resume_equation (c : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R)
    (k : Comp R Empty) (v : Value R Empty) :
    substComp (single v) (graphContinuation c k) =
      graphContextPlug c (substComp (single v) k) := by
  induction c with
  | hole => rfl
  | bind c body ih =>
      simp only [graphContinuation, substComp, graphContextPlug, ih]
      rw [comp_rename_cancel (graphComp body) (Original.up Nat.succ) (lift (single v))
        (lift_cancel Nat.succ (single v) (fun _ => rfl))]
  | scope owner c ih => exact congrArg (Comp.scope owner) ih
  | expose ev rv c ih => exact congrArg (Comp.expose ev rv) ih

/-- Old contextual suspension becomes a genuine combined root request. This
statement retains the exact instance and payload, and derives K typing from
the old full computation and actual propagation, rather than assuming it. -/
theorem graph_request_correspondence (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R)
    (hg : HigherOrderGraph.WellTyped g xi)
    (c : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R) (op : OperationInstance)
    (p : HigherOrderGraph.Value R Empty) (k : HigherOrderGraph.Comp R Empty)
    (ht : HigherOrderGraph.CompTyped xi HigherOrderGraph.emptyTy emptyContext
      (c.plug (.request op p k)) a) :
    ∃ events, Prefix (liftGraph g) (graphComp (c.plug (.request op p k))) events
        (.request op (graphValue p) (graphContinuation c (graphComp k))) ∧
      ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext (graphValue p) op.payloadType ∧
      CompTyped xi emptyTy (extend emptyContext op.responseType)
        (graphContinuation c (graphComp k)) a ∧
      (∀ response : Value R Empty,
        substComp (single response) (graphContinuation c (graphComp k)) =
          graphContextPlug c (substComp (single response) (graphComp k))) := by
  obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := propagate_graph_request (graph := liftGraph g) c op (graphValue p) (graphComp k)
  have start : CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext
      (graphContextPlug c (.request op (graphValue p) (graphComp k))) a := by
    simpa only [graph_plug, graphComp] using (graphComp_typed ht)
  have finish := prefix_preservation (liftGraph_typed hg) trace start
  cases finish with
  | request hp hk =>
      refine ⟨events, ?_, hp, hk, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [graph_plug, graphComp] using trace
      · intro response
        exact graph_resume_equation c (graphComp k) response

theorem graph_failure_correspondence (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R)
    (c : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R) (reason : Original.Failure) :
    ∃ events, Prefix (liftGraph g) (graphComp (c.plug (.fail reason))) events (.fail reason) := by
  simpa only [graph_plug, graphComp] using
    (propagate_graph_failure (graph := liftGraph g) c reason)

/-- For an old response, the resumption is literally the embedding of the
old saved context plugged around the old response-substituted computation. -/
theorem old_graph_resume_equation (c : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R)
    (k : HigherOrderGraph.Comp R Empty) (v : HigherOrderGraph.Value R Empty) :
    substComp (single (graphValue v)) (graphContinuation c (graphComp k)) =
      graphComp (c.plug (HigherOrderGraph.substComp (HigherOrderGraph.Safety.single v) k)) := by
  rw [graph_resume_equation, graph_plug, graph_substitute_top]

/-- Apply the captured typing back to every independently typed response and
every raw internal prefix. No linear-use premise is imposed on the same K. -/
theorem graph_resumption_safety (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R)
    (hg : HigherOrderGraph.WellTyped g xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (HigherOrderGraph.projectGraph g))
    (c : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.EvalContext R) (op : OperationInstance)
    (p : HigherOrderGraph.Value R Empty) (k : HigherOrderGraph.Comp R Empty)
    (ht : HigherOrderGraph.CompTyped xi HigherOrderGraph.emptyTy emptyContext
      (c.plug (.request op p k)) a)
    (response : Value R Empty) (hr : ValueTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext response op.responseType)
    (trace : Prefix (liftGraph g)
      (substComp (single response) (graphContinuation c (graphComp k))) events last) :
    CompTyped xi emptyTy emptyContext last a ∧ CanProgress (liftGraph g) last := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hk, _⟩ := graph_request_correspondence g hg c op p k ht
  exact finite_prefix_safety (liftGraph_typed hg) (liftGraph_guard g guard)
    (substitute_top hk hr) trace

/-- The exact old allocation supplier is consumed before embedding. Handler h
is independently typed in the new allocated graph and may itself contain graph
references and arbitrary combined bodies. No fresh node typing/rank oracle. -/
theorem source_rec_under_handler
    {g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R} {nu : Fin n → Ty}
    (hg : HigherOrderGraph.WellTyped g xi)
    (guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (HigherOrderGraph.projectGraph g))
    (rhs : Fin n → HigherOrder.Value)
    (hrhs : ∀ s, HigherOrder.ValueTyped (HigherOrderGraph.sourceContext nu env) (rhs s) (nu s))
    (hcapture : HigherOrderGraph.CapturesTyped xi env capture)
    (hcycle : HigherOrderGraph.FreshNoCycle (HigherOrderGraph.sourceFresh capture rhs))
    (hbody : HigherOrder.CompTyped (HigherOrderGraph.sourceContext nu env) body a)
    (hh : HandlerTyped (HigherOrderGraph.joinTy xi nu) emptyTy emptyContext h a b)
    (trace : Prefix (liftGraph (HigherOrderGraph.allocate g (HigherOrderGraph.sourceFresh capture rhs)))
      (.handle h (graphComp (HigherOrderGraph.sourceCloseComp capture n body))) events last) :
    CompTyped (HigherOrderGraph.joinTy xi nu) emptyTy emptyContext last b ∧
      CanProgress (liftGraph (HigherOrderGraph.allocate g (HigherOrderGraph.sourceFresh capture rhs))) last := by
  obtain ⟨allocated, ⟨guarded⟩, closedBody⟩ :=
    HigherOrderGraph.source_rec_allocation hg guard rhs hrhs hcapture hcycle hbody
  exact finite_prefix_safety (liftGraph_typed allocated) (liftGraph_guard _ guarded)
    (.handle hh (graphComp_typed closedBody)) trace


theorem graph_prefix (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R)
    (trace : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.Steps g m events n) :
    Prefix (liftGraph g) (graphComp m) (events.map graphEvent) (graphComp n) := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | cons step _ ih => exact .cons (graph_step g step) ih

theorem handler_prefix (trace : HigherOrder.Handler.Prefix m events n) :
    Prefix graph (handlerComp m) (events.map handlerEvent) (handlerComp n) := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | cons step _ ih => exact .cons (handler_step step) ih

/-- Every old suspension, not merely a selected context, has finite root
propagation. The stronger request theorem above supplies its typed resumption. -/
theorem graph_suspended_root (g : HigherOrderGraph.Graph R)
    (hs : HigherOrderGraph.Safety.Suspended m) :
    ∃ events n, Prefix (liftGraph g) (graphComp m) events n ∧ Terminal n := by
  rcases HigherOrderGraph.Safety.suspended_decomposition hs with
    ⟨c, reason, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, op, p, k, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := graph_failure_correspondence g c reason
    exact ⟨events, _, trace, .failed reason⟩
  · obtain ⟨events, trace⟩ := propagate_graph_request (graph := liftGraph g) c op (graphValue p) (graphComp k)
    exact ⟨events, _, by simpa only [graph_plug, graphComp] using trace, .requested _ _ _⟩

namespace Examples

def unitTy : Ty := .base .unit
def boolTy : Ty := .base .bool
def resultTy : Ty := .union unitTy boolTy
def op : OperationInstance := ⟨20, [], unitTy, unitTy⟩
def nextOp : OperationInstance := ⟨21, [], unitTy, boolTy⟩
def recursiveK : Comp Bool Empty := .dynamicCall (.ref false) (.delay (.ret (.var 0)))
def recursiveBody : Comp Bool Empty := .request op .unit recursiveK
def consumer : Adapter Bool Empty := .mk unitTy unitTy (.ret (.var 0)) [] []
def recursiveLambda : Value Bool Empty :=
  .lambda .computation ⟨[], []⟩ unitTy unitTy unitTy recursiveBody consumer

/-- The recursive reference occurs in actual request continuation code. The
other node is a returned union carrier observed by an actual wait rule. -/
def graph : Graph Bool
  | false => recursiveLambda
  | true => .inRight (.bool true)
def types : Bool → Ty
  | false => .callable unitTy unitTy
  | true => resultTy

theorem graph_typed : WellTyped graph types := by
  intro r
  cases r with
  | false => exact .lambdaComputation
      (.request .unit (.dynamicCall (.ref false) (.delay (.ret (.var rfl)))))
      (.mk (.ret (.var rfl)))
  | true => exact .inRight .bool

def guard : GuardedValueGraph.Guarded (projectGraph graph) where
  rank := fun _ => 0
  ceiling := 1
  bound := fun _ => Nat.zero_lt_succ 0
  decrease := by intro r s h; cases r <;> cases h

def handler : Handler Bool Empty := .mk 70 unitTy boolTy
  (.cons (.ret (.ref true)) .nil) (.cons op true (.ret (.ref true)) .nil)

theorem handler_typed : HandlerTyped types emptyTy env handler unitTy boolTy :=
  .mk (.cons (.ret (.ref true)) .nil) (.cons (.ret (.ref true)) .nil)

def recursiveProgram : Comp Bool Empty :=
  .handle handler (.dynamicCall (.ref false) (.delay (.ret .unit)))

theorem recursiveProgram_typed : CompTyped types emptyTy emptyContext recursiveProgram boolTy :=
  .handle handler_typed (.dynamicCall (.ref false) (.delay (.ret .unit)))

/-- Full real recursive lambda entry, rootward request propagation, shallow
selection, attempt evaluation, graph lookup inside wait, and Yes return. -/
theorem recursive_request_handler_execution :
    ∃ events, Prefix graph recursiveProgram events (.ret (.bool true)) := by
  refine ⟨_, .cons (.handle .callRef) ?_⟩
  refine .cons (.handle .callLambda) ?_
  refine .cons (.handle .bindRequest) ?_
  refine .cons .handleRequest ?_
  refine .cons .operationCons ?_
  exact .cons .operationRef (.cons .operationYes (.refl _))

theorem recursive_every_prefix_safe (trace : Prefix graph recursiveProgram events n) :
    CompTyped types emptyTy emptyContext n boolTy ∧ CanProgress graph n :=
  finite_prefix_safety graph_typed guard recursiveProgram_typed trace

/-- The selected arm still receives K:unit→unit. H K has result bool. -/
theorem two_continuations :
    ValueTyped types emptyTy emptyContext (continuationValue unitTy unitTy recursiveK)
      (.callable unitTy unitTy) ∧
    CompTyped types emptyTy (extend emptyContext unitTy)
      (forwardedContinuation handler recursiveK) boolTy :=
  ⟨continuationValue_typed (.dynamicCall (.ref false) (.delay (.ret (.var rfl)))),
    forwardedContinuation_typed handler_typed (.dynamicCall (.ref false) (.delay (.ret (.var rfl))))⟩

def nestedWait : Comp Bool Empty :=
  .waitOperation handler op .unit (.ret (.var 0)) .nil
    (.request nextOp .unit (.ret (.ref true)))
def restoredWait : Comp Bool Empty :=
  .waitOperation (renameHandler Nat.succ handler) op (renameValue Nat.succ .unit)
    (renameComp (Original.up Nat.succ) (.ret (.var 0)))
    (renameOperationArms Nat.succ .nil) (.ret (.ref true))

theorem nestedWait_typed : CompTyped types emptyTy emptyContext nestedWait boolTy :=
  .waitOperation handler_typed .unit (.ret (.var rfl)) .nil (.request .unit (.ret (.ref true)))

theorem nested_restoration : Step graph nestedWait .silent (.request nextOp .unit restoredWait) :=
  .operationRequest

theorem nested_restoration_typed :
    CompTyped types emptyTy emptyContext (.request nextOp .unit restoredWait) boolTy :=
  preservation graph_typed nested_restoration nestedWait_typed

/-- Arbitrary typed response is consumed by the exact restored wait. Its
pending graph-backed trial then resumes and returns Yes. -/
theorem nested_response_execution (response : Value Bool Empty) :
    Prefix graph (substComp (single response) restoredWait)
      [.lookup true, .silent] (.ret (.bool true)) :=
  .cons .operationRef (.cons .operationYes (.refl _))

theorem nested_response_safe (response : Value Bool Empty)
    (hr : ValueTyped types emptyTy emptyContext response boolTy)
    (trace : Prefix graph (substComp (single response) restoredWait) events last) :
    CompTyped types emptyTy emptyContext last boolTy ∧ CanProgress graph last := by
  have hk : CompTyped types emptyTy (extend emptyContext boolTy) restoredWait boolTy := by
    have h := nested_restoration_typed
    cases h with
    | request _ hk => exact hk
  exact finite_prefix_safety graph_typed guard (substitute_top hk hr) trace

end Examples
